title: Brave Hearts Rising
lines: Lord Jesus, You are strong when we feel small,
Give us courage like a lion's roar,
Help us try new things without fear,
Walk beside us into scary places,
Today I want to be brave about ______,
Remind us You are never far away,
Turn our shaky knees into steady steps,
togetherLine: With You beside us, we can be brave. Amen.

title: Circle of Good Friends
lines: God of laughter and long afternoons,
Thank You for the friends who make us smile,
Teach us to share our toys and our snacks,
Help us say sorry when we're unkind,
Bless my friend named ______ today,
Show us how to include the lonely one,
Grow our friendships strong like old oak trees,
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for friends who feel like family. Amen.

title: Sunshine on Our Faces
lines: Thank You for this brand-new morning, God!
The sun is up and so are we,
Fill our hearts with wiggly, giggly joy,
Thank You for birds singing outside,
Help us wake up kind, not grumpy,
I'm thankful this morning for ______,
Make today sparkle like the morning dew,
togetherLine: This is the day You made—we will be glad in it! Amen.

title: When Everything Feels Heavy
lines: Father, today feels heavy, like a big backpack,
You know the tears we tried to hide,
Help us breathe slow when we want to cry,
Carry the part we cannot carry ourselves,
Right now the hardest thing is ______,
Sit with us until the storm gets quiet,
Remind us tomorrow can be different,
togetherLine: Even on hard days, You never let go of us. Amen.

title: Gentle Hands That Mend
lines: Lord, You know every ache we carry,
Some hurts are on the outside, some inside,
Wrap Your gentle hands around the sore places,
Thank You for doctors and for band-aids,
Please help ______ feel better soon,
Turn our worry into quiet trust,
Mend what's broken, bit by bit,
togetherLine: Great Healer, make us whole again. Amen.

title: Pencils and New Ideas
lines: God of numbers, letters, and new ideas,
Thank You for pencils sharp and pages fresh,
Help our minds grow like seeds in spring,
Give us patience when the lessons feel hard,
Let us be kind to friends who sit near us,
Today I want to learn about ______,
Fill our school days with wonder and light.
togetherLine: Teach us, guide us, we belong to You. Amen.

title: Stars Watch Over Us
lines: Quiet Lord, the day is folding like a blanket,
The stars are waking up outside our window,
We give You our worries, big and small,
Wrap us in peace as we close our eyes,
Watch over Mom and Dad while they sleep,
Tonight I trust You with ______,
Let morning come gentle and full of light.
togetherLine: We rest in You, safe through the night. Amen.

title: Hands Across the World
lines: Lord of every mountain, desert, and sea,
Bless the missionaries far away from home,
Give them courage in a language not their own,
Help them find friends where they feel like strangers,
Let Your love travel farther than any road,
We pray today for the people of ______,
Use even our small hands to help the world.
togetherLine: Send us, use us, the whole world is Yours. Amen.

title: Light for Tricky Choices
lines: Whisper to us, Lord, when we don't know what to do,
Give us wisdom bigger than our years,
Help us pause before we speak too fast,
Show us right from wrong like a lamp on the path,
Let us listen more and argue less,
Today help me choose wisely about ______,
Grow good sense in us like roots in the ground.
togetherLine: Make us wise, make us Yours. Amen.

title: Small Acts, Big Love
lines: Thank You, God, for hearts that notice others!
Help us share before we're even asked,
Let a kind word be our first response,
Show us who needs a smile today,
Make our hands quick to help, slow to hurt,
Today I want to be kind to ______,
Plant kindness in us that grows and grows.
togetherLine: Make us kind, like You are kind to us. Amen.

title: The World You Keep Turning
lines: God of frost and blooming trees,
You paint the sky in colors new,
Summer sun and winter freeze,
All the seasons come from You.
Thank You for the rain that falls,
And the snow that blankets ground,
Today I thank You for ______.
togetherLine: For every season, Lord, we praise Your name. Amen.

title: Under Your Watchful Wing
lines: Father, wrap us in Your care,
Like a shield around our home,
You watch us sleeping, You watch us play,
We never walk alone.
When the thunder shakes the night,
Your love is our safest place,
Keep ______ safe today, we pray.
togetherLine: Lord, hold our family close tonight. Amen.

title: Open Hands, Open Hearts
lines: Thank You, Lord, for full cupboards and warm coats,
For toys to share and snacks to split,
Teach our hands to give, not grip,
Like You gave everything to us.
Help us notice who has less,
And share our blessings, big or small,
I want to give ______ to someone today.
togetherLine: Make our hearts as open as Your hands. Amen.

title: Bold Steps in the Dark
lines: Lord, when the shadows stretch long,
And my knees begin to shake,
Remind me that You are strong,
And courage is Yours to make.
Help me try the scary thing,
Help me speak when I feel small,
Give me courage for ______ today.
togetherLine: With You beside us, we are brave. Amen.

title: Laughter We Share Together
lines: God of giggles and side-by-side walks,
Thank You for friends who understand,
For secrets kept and silly talks,
And someone reaching out a hand.
Help us be kind when friends feel sad,
Help us forgive when feelings bend,
Thank You, God, for my friend ______.
togetherLine: Bless every friendship we hold dear. Amen.

title: Threads That Tie Us Close
lines: How good it is, Lord, to belong to this family!
Thank You for the hands that hug us tight.
Thank You for the voices that call us home.
Help us be kind when we bump and disagree.
Teach us to forgive as fast as we fuss.
Today I love ______ with my whole heart.
Bind us close like branches on one tree.
togetherLine: Lord, keep our family strong and full of love. Amen.

title: Enough for Today
lines: Lord, we don't need more toys to be happy.
You give us just enough, right on time.
Help us stop wishing for what we don't have.
Thank You for simple things that fill our days.
Teach our hearts to rest instead of race.
Today I'm thankful just for ______.
Show us the joy in what's already ours.
togetherLine: God, teach us to be happy with what You give. Amen.

title: Hearts Full of Thanks
lines: Every gift we hold today comes from Your hand, God.
Thank You for breakfast crumbs and warm bathwater.
Thank You for silly jokes that make us snort.
Thank You for shoes that fit and beds that hold us.
Help us notice blessings hiding in plain sight.
Today I want to thank You for ______.
Turn our grumbling into a song of thanks.
togetherLine: We thank You, God, for everything You give. Amen.

title: Curious Minds at Work
lines: Lord, fill our minds like jars waiting to be filled.
Thank You for teachers who help us grow.
Give us patience when the answers hide from us.
Help us try again when spelling gets tricky.
Make us brave to raise our hands and ask.
Today I want to learn more about ______.
Turn every mistake into a stepping stone.
togetherLine: God, help us learn and grow each day. Amen.

title: Safe in Your Quiet Hands
lines: Jesus, the house grows still and dark now.
We close our eyes and know You're near.
Thank You for keeping watch while we dream.
Wash away today's worries like rain on a window.
Hold ______ safe through the whole dark night.
Let peace tuck in every corner of our room.
We trust You till the morning light returns.
togetherLine: Lord Jesus, watch over us as we sleep. Amen.

title: Fresh Pages Turning
lines: Lord, You make all things new again,
old pages turn and fresh ones begin.
Thank You for mornings that start us over,
for second chances You give us, forever.
Help ______ step into this new beginning,
with courage and hope, not fear or worry.
You go before us into what's coming.
togetherLine: Lord, make us new, and lead us on—Amen.

title: Roads That Lead Home
lines: God of every road and rest stop,
watch over wheels and wings that carry us.
Keep us safe from start to finish,
through traffic, clouds, or bumpy paths.
Bless ______ as we travel together,
and bring us safely to where we're going.
Thank You for adventures waiting ahead.
togetherLine: Lord, be our guide on every journey—Amen.

title: Waiting Without Worry
lines: Jesus, sometimes waiting feels so hard,
like standing still when we want to run.
Teach us to breathe slow when we're frustrated,
and trust Your timing more than our own.
Help ______ wait with a peaceful heart,
even when the answer isn't yet.
Good things grow slowly, just like we do.
togetherLine: Lord, teach us patience, one moment at a time—Amen.

title: Rhythms You Have Made
lines: Maker of falling leaves and budding branches,
You paint the sky a different color each season.
Thank You for snow that blankets the ground,
and sun that warms the earth again.
Show ______ Your wonder in every changing season,
in rain, in wind, in blossoms and frost.
Your seasons turn like a steady song.
togetherLine: Lord of the seasons, we praise Your design—Amen.

title: Shield Around Our Family
lines: Father, You stand as a wall around us,
a shield when danger comes too close.
Thank You for angels watching while we sleep,
for strength when we feel small and scared.
Protect ______ wherever they may wander,
keep danger far and courage near.
We rest inside Your steady care.
togetherLine: Lord, be our shield today and always—Amen.

title: Faces Down Our Street
lines: Lord, You know every name on our street,
bless the ones who wave and the ones who stay quiet.
Help us bring soup when someone feels sick,
and share our swing when new kids arrive.
Teach us to knock on doors with kindness,
today I want to be a good neighbor to ______,
show us who needs a friend this week.
togetherLine: Lord, make us good neighbors, near and far. Amen.

title: Quiet Rivers Inside Us
lines: God of calm waters and settled hearts,
slow our fast feet and our loud voices.
When arguments spark, help us breathe first.
Untangle the knots inside our chests.
Let peace sit with us at the table.
right now I give You my worry about ______,
wrap our home in Your steady calm.
togetherLine: Lord, be the peace we carry today. Amen.

title: The People We Call Family
lines: Jesus, thank You for the pews we know so well,
and the songs we sing loud and off-key.
Bless the ones who teach us and pray for us.
Help us welcome new faces with open arms.
Grow us together like branches on one vine.
I'm grateful for ______ who helps at our church,
make our church a home for anyone who wanders in.
togetherLine: Lord, build us together as Your church. Amen.

title: Knit From the Same Heart
lines: Father, You stitched our family together on purpose,
no two of us alike, yet all of us Yours.
Thank You for hugs that squeeze away hard days.
Thank You for jokes only we understand.
Help us forgive quickly and love loudly.
today I want to show extra love to ______,
keep our hearts knit close, even when we're apart.
togetherLine: Lord, thank You for loving us into a family. Amen.

title: Happy With What's Here
lines: Lord, teach our hearts to rest in what we have,
not always reaching for one thing more.
Thank You for the shoes that still fit fine.
Thank You for the meal already on the table.
Help us notice joy in ordinary moments.
today I'm content with ______, even without more,
fill our hearts full so we stop chasing empty things.
togetherLine: Lord, You are enough, and so is today. Amen.

title: Washed Clean Again
lines: God of second chances, we come with open hands.
Sorry is a small word that carries so much love.
Wash away the sharp words we didn't mean to say.
Help me forgive my ______ when my heart feels tight.
You never keep a list of all our mess-ups, Lord.
Soften us like clay so grace can shape us new.
Thank You for hugs that come after the sorry.
togetherLine: We forgive and we are forgiven—thank You, Lord. Amen.

title: Carrying Each Other's Tears
lines: Jesus, You see every tear before it falls.
We think of friends whose hearts feel heavy today.
Wrap Your arms around ______ who is hurting right now.
Give doctors and helpers gentle hands and kind words.
Let us be a soft place for someone who is sad.
You collect every tear, Lord, not one is wasted.
Turn our worry into prayers that reach the sky.
togetherLine: Comfort every hurting heart tonight, Lord. Amen.

title: Truth Like Morning Light
lines: Lord, You are truth, plain and shining like the sun.
Help our words match what is really in our hearts.
Give me courage to tell the truth about ______.
Even small fibs can grow into big tangles, Lord.
Teach us that honest is always braver than easy.
You always tell us the truth in love, God.
Let our yes be yes and our no be no.
togetherLine: Keep our hearts honest and our words true. Amen.

title: First Light, Fresh Start
lines: Father, the morning breaks and old mistakes fall away.
Every sunrise is a page You haven't written yet.
We bring You our fresh start with hopeful hearts.
Help me try again at ______ without giving up.
You make beginnings out of endings, Lord, again and again.
Nothing is too broken for Your hands to remake.
Walk with us into whatever is new today.
togetherLine: Thank You for new beginnings, Lord—lead us on. Amen.

title: Wheels, Wings, and Wonder
lines: God of every mile we travel, ride along with us.
Bless the roads, the runways, and the paths ahead.
Keep our car, our plane, our feet steady and safe.
Watch over ______ while we're far from home.
Thank You for new sights and new faces to meet.
Bring us safely to where we are going, Lord.
And bring us safely home again when we're done.
togetherLine: Travel with us, Lord, and bring us home safe. Amen.

title: Walls That Hold Our Laughter
lines: Jesus, this house holds all our noise and laughter,
thank You for the table where we eat together,
thank You for my bed so soft at night,
thank You for the door that welcomes friends inside,
bless the corner where ______ likes to play,
keep our home warm when storms blow outside,
let kindness live in every room we share.
togetherLine: In this home, we belong to You and to each other. Amen.

title: Hands Ready to Help
lines: God, You gave us hands for helping, not just holding,
show me someone today who needs a friend,
help me share my snack without being asked,
help me carry something heavy for someone else,
today I want to help ______ with something kind,
teach us that small helps can feel like big love,
make our whole family quick to lend a hand.
togetherLine: Use our hands, Lord, to serve like Jesus served. Amen.

title: Dancing Hearts Today
lines: What a joyful day You've given us to celebrate!
thank You for cake and candles and confetti too,
thank You for songs that make us want to dance,
thank You for birthdays and for days marked just because,
today I'm especially thankful for ______,
let our laughter rise up like a happy shout,
remind us every good gift comes from You.
togetherLine: We celebrate You, God, in every happy moment. Amen.

title: Doors We Knock On
lines: Lord, the houses on our street hold whole worlds,
help us wave and smile at the people nearby,
help us notice when a neighbor seems alone,
give us courage to bring soup or bread,
today let's pray by name for ______ next door,
teach us to love the ones close by, not just far away,
make our street a place where kindness travels fast.
togetherLine: Lord, help us love our neighbors just like You do. Amen.

title: Calm Beneath the Noise
lines: Father, quiet down the worry in our chests,
still the loud thoughts that spin inside our heads,
breathe Your calm into our busy, bumpy day,
help us take slow breaths when feelings get too big,
bring peace tonight to ______ who needs it most,
settle arguments with gentle words, not shouting,
let peace sit with us like a quiet friend.
togetherLine: Fill us with peace, Lord, deep down in our hearts. Amen.

title: Songs the Morning Sings
lines: Good morning, God, the world woke up today,
Birds are singing right outside our door,
Sunlight spills like gold across the floor,
Thank You for my ______ waiting just for me,
Fill our hearts with laughter, light and free,
Help our feet go skipping, not just walking,
Make this whole day sparkle, bright and new.
togetherLine: Together we say: this is the day You made! Amen.

title: When My Heart Feels Tired
lines: Some days climb like hills too steep for me,
My shoes feel heavy, my smile hides away,
Lord, sit beside me when it's hard to be brave,
Remind me You are stronger than my ______,
Help me breathe slow when things feel loud,
Send someone kind to walk with me today,
Carry the parts I cannot carry alone.
togetherLine: Even on hard days, You never let go. Amen.

title: Mend What Hurts Inside
lines: Jesus, You touched the sick and made them new,
Reach out Your hand to where it hurts today,
Heal my ______ and make it strong again,
Comfort the ones who ache in beds tonight,
Let doctors' hands be gentle, wise, and sure,
Wrap tired bodies in Your steady care,
Turn our tears to laughter in Your time.
togetherLine: You are the God who makes broken things whole. Amen.

title: Sorry and Starting Over
lines: Father, I said a word I wish I hadn't,
Forgive the times I pushed my sister away,
Soften my heart when I want to stay mad,
Help me forgive my ______ the way You forgive me,
Show me how to say I'm sorry first,
Wash away the grumpy feelings inside,
Give us fresh starts before the sun goes down.
togetherLine: Forgiven and free, we begin again. Amen.

title: Someone Needs You Tonight
lines: Lord, somewhere out there someone feels alone,
Some children are hungry, some hearts are sad,
Be near to the ones who cry in the dark,
We pray for my ______ who's having a hard week,
Show us small ways to share and to give,
Let kindness travel from our hands to theirs,
Remind the hurting they are not forgotten.
togetherLine: Use us, Lord, to bring comfort to others. Amen.

title: Voices Across the Sea
lines: God of every ocean and every open door,
send courage to the ones who leave home for You.
Bless the teachers, healers, friends who share Your name,
keep them warm when nights turn cold and strange.
Grow Your love in places we may never see,
and use my ______ to help someone far away.
Watch over every traveler on Your long, good road,
togetherLine: Lord, carry Your love to the ends of the earth. Amen.

title: Thoughts That Find the Way
lines: Wise God, You know the way when we don't,
give us minds that ask before they answer.
Help me think before my words jump out,
and listen twice as much as I speak.
Teach ______ to choose what's right, not just easy,
Fill our home with patience when answers are slow,
Grow good sense in us like roots underground,
togetherLine: Lord, make us wise in small things and large. Amen.

title: Soft Words, Strong Hearts
lines: Jesus, You noticed the ones others passed by,
teach us to notice too, right where we stand.
Make my hands quick to share and slow to grab,
soften my words before they leave my mouth.
Help ______ be kind even when it's hard,
Let kindness ripple out from our small house,
Turn me toward someone who needs a friend today,
togetherLine: God, make our kindness bigger than our mood. Amen.

title: Walls That Know Our Names
lines: Father, this house is small but full of You,
thank You for the roof that keeps us dry.
Bless the table where we share our food,
and the beds where tired bodies rest.
Let peace live in every room we share,
Help ______ feel safe within these walls,
Make our home a place that welcomes others in,
togetherLine: Lord, live with us here, in every corner. Amen.

title: Give Me a Job to Do
lines: God, You knelt to wash Your friends' tired feet,
show us small jobs we can do today.
Let me carry, fix, or clean without complaint,
and serve without needing anyone to see.
Give ______ a heart that looks for ways to help,
Turn our family into helpers, not just talkers,
Use our simple work to show Your love,
togetherLine: Lord, let us serve like You served us. Amen.

title: Cups That Overflow
lines: God of overflowing cups, teach our hands to share.
You gave us more than we could hold alone.
Let us pass the bread before we're asked.
Show us pockets we can empty for a friend.
Today I want to give ______ away with joy.
Make our giving light, not heavy with worry.
Fill us up so we can pour out again.
togetherLine: We give because You gave us everything first. Amen.

title: Lion Hearts Wake Up
lines: Lord Jesus, You walked toward storms without flinching.
Put steel in my knees when I want to run.
Help me speak up when the room goes quiet.
Today I'm scared of ______, but I won't hide.
Stand beside me when the dark feels close.
Turn my shaky voice into a strong one.
Courage isn't loud — sometimes it's just staying.
togetherLine: We are brave because You never let go. Amen.

title: Room for One More
lines: Father, thank You for the ones who sit beside me.
You knew Adam needed more than trees and rivers.
Bless the friend who saves me a seat.
Help me be the first to say hello.
Today I'm thankful for ______, my good friend.
Teach me to listen with my whole face.
Make room at our table for one more.
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for friends who feel like home. Amen.

title: Toast and New Beginnings
lines: Hooray, another morning to jump into today!
The birds already started singing without us.
Thank You for toast and socks and sunny windows.
Fill my heart with giggles before breakfast.
Today I'm excited about ______ waiting for me.
Wake up my sleepy joy, God, right now.
Let this whole day bounce with happy feet.
togetherLine: This is the day You made — let's be glad in it! Amen.

title: Storm Clouds Pass Over
lines: God, today felt like wading through mud.
Nothing went the way I hoped it would.
My chest feels tight and my eyes feel hot.
Sit with me in this gray, tired place.
Right now I need help with ______.
Remind me that storms don't stay forever.
Hold my hand until the sun comes back.
togetherLine: You are close to us even on hard days. Amen.

title: Counting Blessings Like Stars
lines: Thank You, God, for breakfast crumbs and warm socks on cold floors,
for the crunch of leaves and the click of closing doors.
Thank You for the friend who shared their swing today,
for silly jokes that made our whole table sway.
Today I'm especially thankful for ______,
small gifts we almost forget to see,
You fill our ordinary hours with things we didn't earn.
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for more than we can count. Amen.

title: Brains Wide Open
lines: God of numbers, letters, and things we've never seen,
wake up my brain like sunrise breaking clean.
Help me try again when my answer comes out wrong,
and help me sit still, even when the day feels long.
Today at school I want to learn about ______,
give me a friend to sit with when I'm new,
and thank You for teachers who patiently push us through.
togetherLine: God, make our minds ready and our hearts brave to learn. Amen.

title: Folding Into Night
lines: Lord, the lamp is dim and the blankets pulled up tight,
fold my worries into Your pocket for the night.
I don't have to guard the corners of this room,
You're awake when the stars begin to bloom.
Tonight I hand You my thoughts about ______,
so my body can rest and my mind can stop its race,
wrap our whole house in Your quiet, steady grace.
togetherLine: We rest in You tonight, safe and unafraid. Amen.

title: Far Off Kitchens and Villages
lines: God of jungles, cities, deserts, and snow,
bless the ones who packed their bags to go.
Bless the missionary learning words that sound so new,
give them courage and a friend or two.
Bless the children far away who play like ______,
under a different sky, but loved the same by You,
knit our hearts to strangers we may never meet.
togetherLine: God, use us to love the whole wide world. Amen.

title: Owl Eyes and Open Ears
lines: Father, give me eyes that notice more than what is loud,
and ears that listen closely in a crowd.
When I don't know if a choice is right or wrong,
whisper Your wisdom till my heart grows strong.
Help me be wise today when I face ______,
not the loudest voice, but the truest one instead,
fill up the quiet spaces inside my head.
togetherLine: Lord, make us wise and keep our hearts humble. Amen.

title: Slow Down My Heart
lines: Lord, my feet want to run before You say go,
teach me to wait like a seed under snow.
When my brother takes too long to tie his shoe,
help me breathe slow and remember I love him too.
Give ______ patience when things don't go their way,
and quiet my grumbles when I have to stay.
You are never in a hurry, You are never late.
togetherLine: Slow us down, Lord, and teach us how to wait. Amen.

title: Seasons Painted by You
lines: God, You paint the trees a new color each fall,
and wake up the flowers when winter's soft call fades.
You send the snow to blanket the sleepy ground,
and fill the summer air with the cricket's sound.
______ loves the season when the air smells like rain,
thank You for each one, again and again.
Every leaf and snowflake was shaped by Your hand.
togetherLine: We praise You, God, for the seasons You planned. Amen.

title: Guarded Through the Night
lines: Father, You stand at the door when the dark comes creeping,
and watch over all of us while we are sleeping.
No shadow is stronger than Your mighty arm,
You keep our whole family safe from harm.
Guard ______ today wherever they may roam,
and bring every one of us safely back home.
We rest in Your love like a bird in its nest.
togetherLine: Keep us close, Father, You know what is best. Amen.

title: A Heart That Shares Freely
lines: Thank You, Lord, for more than we could ever need,
help us plant it like a tiny generous seed.
When a friend has none and we still have two,
show us how to share just like You do.
Let ______ give something away today,
a smile, a snack, a kind word to say.
What we hold loosely, You multiply and bless.
togetherLine: Make our hearts generous, Lord, nothing less. Amen.

title: Brave When Knees Shake
lines: Jesus, my knees shake when the dark stairs creak,
but You are strong when I feel weak.
Give me courage for the test, the jump, the try,
and help me stand tall when I want to cry.
Be brave with ______ when their heart feels small,
You are the One who catches us when we fall.
Fear is loud, but You are so much louder.
togetherLine: Make us brave, Jesus, one step at a time. Amen.

title: Pews Where We Belong
lines: Lord, we walk through doors that welcome us in,
voices rise together like one big song.
Thank You for teachers who show us Your word,
and friends who sit close on the wooden benches.
Bless the hands that pass the bread and cup,
and the ones who sweep the floors when we're gone.
At church, ______ feels close to You, God.
togetherLine: Together: Make our church a home for every heart. Amen.

title: Woven By Your Love
lines: Father, You gave us each other to hold,
arms that hug tight when the day gets hard.
Thank You for laughter that fills our kitchen,
and quiet moments when words aren't needed.
Teach us to forgive when feelings get hurt,
and to choose kindness even when we're tired.
God, help ______ feel loved every single day.
togetherLine: Together: Thank You, God, for making us a family. Amen.

title: Peace With What I Have
lines: God, my toys don't need to be new,
my house is warm and my bed is soft.
Help me stop wishing for what's on the shelf,
and see the good gifts already in my hands.
Thank You for shoes that fit my feet,
and food that fills my hungry tummy.
Lord, let ______ feel happy with just today.
togetherLine: Together: We have enough because You are enough. Amen.

title: Counting Every Small Gift
lines: Thank You, God, for the sun through my window,
for birds that sing before I even wake.
Thank You for hands that tie my shoes,
and voices that call me to come and eat.
Thank You for silly jokes and big bear hugs,
and for tucking me in when the stars come out.
Lord, ______ says thank You for this good day.
togetherLine: Together: Every good gift comes down from You. Amen.

title: Building Blocks of Wonder
lines: Lord, my pencil is sharp and my mind is ready,
help me learn new things today.
Thank You for teachers who explain things twice,
and friends who help when I get stuck.
Give me patience when the answers hide,
and joy when I finally understand.
God, help ______ grow smarter and kinder too.
togetherLine: Together: Fill our minds with wonder and truth. Amen.

title: Words That Tell True
lines: Jesus, You always tell the truth, help me do the same.
When I want to hide a mistake, give me courage to speak.
Let my yes be yes and my no be no.
Keep my words matching what's in my heart.
Today I want to be honest about ______.
Even when honesty is hard, stay close beside me.
Thank You for loving me even when I mess up.
togetherLine: Together we choose truth, today and always. Amen.

title: Doors Swing Open Wide
lines: God of mornings, You make all things new.
Old mistakes don't have to follow me forward.
Help me start again with a light heart.
Give me courage for this new beginning.
Today I want a fresh start with ______.
Turn my worries into hope for what's next.
Thank You for second chances every day.
togetherLine: We step forward together, trusting You. Amen.

title: Miles We Trust to You
lines: Lord, You go before us on every road.
Watch over cars, planes, and boats that carry us.
Keep us safe when the journey feels long.
Help us be patient in traffic and lines.
I'm thankful for adventures with ______.
Guide the driver, pilot, or captain who leads us.
Bring us safely home again.
togetherLine: Travel with us, Lord, wherever we go. Amen.

title: Waiting Hearts Grow Strong
lines: God, waiting is hard, but You are with me.
Slow my heart when I want to rush.
Teach me patience in lines and in traffic.
Help me wait for good things without grumbling.
Give me patience today with ______.
Turn my sighs into quiet trust in You.
Thank You for perfect timing, even when I don't understand.
togetherLine: We wait together, trusting Your perfect timing. Amen.

title: Colors You Paint the Sky
lines: Creator God, You made every season with care.
Thank You for sunshine, rain, snow, and wind.
Help us notice beauty in every changing month.
You paint the leaves and melt the frost away.
My favorite season is ______, thank You for it.
Teach us to wonder at Your handiwork.
All creation sings of Your goodness.
togetherLine: We praise You, Creator, for every season. Amen.

title: Party Hats and Praise
lines: God of confetti and cake, You love a good party!
Thank You for birthdays, and cheers, and bright balloons.
We clap our hands because You made us glad.
Today I want to celebrate ______.
You dance over us with singing, Lord.
Every happy day is a gift from Your hand.
Let our laughter rise up like music to You.
togetherLine: We celebrate because You are so good to us. Amen.

title: The House Next Door
lines: Lord Jesus, You told us to love the ones nearby.
Thank You for the neighbors who wave from their porch.
Help us bring soup when someone feels sick.
Show us how to be kind to ______.
Let our street feel like a family to everyone on it.
Give us eyes to see who needs a friend today.
Make our home a place where neighbors feel welcome.
togetherLine: Help us love our neighbors like You love us. Amen.

title: Still Waters in Me
lines: Father, when my thoughts feel like a stormy sea, calm them.
You spoke to the wind and the waves grew quiet.
Breathe Your peace into my worried heart tonight.
Help me feel calm about ______.
You are not far away when I feel afraid.
Let peace sit with me like a good friend.
Quiet my hands, quiet my heart, quiet my mind.
togetherLine: Lord, fill our home with Your perfect peace. Amen.

title: The Family We Sing With
lines: God of steeples and open doors, we belong to You.
Thank You for the friends who pray beside us.
We sing loud songs together every single week.
Help me be kind to ______ at church.
Bless the ones who teach us and welcome us in.
Grow our church family closer, Lord, like roots in good soil.
We are glad to gather in Your name.
togetherLine: Lord, thank You for our church family. Amen.

title: Glue That Holds Us
lines: Jesus, You stitched our family together with love.
Thank You for hugs that squeeze away a bad day.
We forgive fast and love even faster here.
Today I'm grateful for ______ in our family.
Even when we argue, Your love mends us again.
Thank You for the ones who tuck me in at night.
Keep our family close, no matter what comes.
togetherLine: Lord, thank You for the love we share. Amen.

title: Where the Ache Goes Quiet
lines: God of bandages and bedtime, You see where it hurts.
My knee is scraped, my tummy aches, but You are near.
Doctors have kind hands, You gave them their knowing.
Rest is medicine too, so we breathe slow and still.
For ______, who doesn't feel good today, send Your gentle strength.
Even when healing takes time, You never leave the room.
Turn our ouchies into stories of how You helped us heal.
togetherLine: Lord, make us well, make us whole, make us Yours. Amen.

title: Letting Go of Grumpy
lines: Jesus, my fists are still clenched from being mad.
Help me open my hands and let the anger fall out.
I said sorry but my heart hasn't caught up yet.
Teach me to forgive like You forgive me, again and again.
______ and I need help making things right between us.
Wash the grumble out of my voice, make it soft.
Friendship is worth more than being right, help me remember.
togetherLine: God, help us forgive fast and love long. Amen.

title: When Someone Else Is Sad
lines: Father, some hearts are heavier than mine tonight.
There are kids who are scared, and grown-ups who are tired.
Help me notice the quiet ones, the ones who don't smile.
Give ______ courage today, wherever they are hurting.
Let our hugs be strong enough to hold someone up.
When words are hard to find, let kindness speak instead.
Use our family to be a light for someone in the dark.
togetherLine: Lord, help us notice and help those who hurt. Amen.

title: Words That Match My Heart
lines: Quiet confession: sometimes the truth feels scary to say.
Help my words match what really happened, not what's easier.
Even little fibs can grow big and heavy inside.
Give me courage to say I broke it instead of hiding.
______ wants to trust me, help me be someone they can.
Your truth is a light, let mine shine that way too.
Thank You for loving me even before I get it right.
togetherLine: God, make our words as true as our hearts. Amen.

title: The Next Page Waits
lines: Hooray, God, something new is starting today!
Yesterday is behind us, and Your mercy made it clean.
Help me try again with a brave and open heart.
New friends, new days, new chances to grow.
______ is starting something new, be with them, Lord.
Whatever we begin, let it begin with You.
Turn every ending into a doorway You walk us through.
togetherLine: Lord, thank You for new starts every single day. Amen.

title: Kind as You Are Kind
lines: Jesus, You are kind to everyone You meet.
Teach my hands to help before I'm asked.
Teach my mouth to say something nice today.
When someone feels left out, let me sit with them.
Today I want to be kind to ______.
Help me share even when it's my favorite thing.
Turn my little kindnesses into big smiles.
togetherLine: God, make our hearts kind like Yours. Amen.

title: This House We Love
lines: Father, thank You for the walls that keep us warm.
Thank You for the table where we share our food.
Thank You for the beds where we rest our heads.
Bless every window, every door, every room.
I'm thankful our home has room for ______.
Help us keep our home full of laughter and peace.
May love live here forever, from floor to roof.
togetherLine: Lord, bless this home we share together. Amen.

title: Serving With Small Hands
lines: Lord, You knelt down and washed dusty feet.
Show me small ways I can serve today.
Maybe I can carry something heavy for someone.
Maybe I can clean up a mess that isn't mine.
Today I want to serve ______.
Let serving others feel like serving You.
Make my hands quick to help, not to complain.
togetherLine: God, use our hands to serve others today. Amen.

title: Joy That Fills the Room
lines: Shout with joy, for God has done great things!
Thank You for birthdays, songs, and silly dances.
Thank You for good news that makes us cheer.
Thank You for friends who celebrate with us.
Today I'm celebrating ______.
Help us clap loud and laugh often.
Every happy moment is a gift from You.
togetherLine: God, we celebrate the joy You give us. Amen.

title: Love Over the Fence
lines: Father, You put neighbors close to our door.
Help me wave hello and mean it every time.
Help me notice when a neighbor needs a friend.
Maybe I can share cookies or a kind note.
Today I want to be kind to ______ next door.
Let our street feel like a place of peace.
Make us good neighbors, patient and warm.
togetherLine: Lord, help us love our neighbors well. Amen.

title: Best Friends Beside Me
lines: Jesus, thank You for the kids who sit with me at lunch.
You made us for laughing together and sharing our snacks.
Thank You for the friend who waits for me at recess.
Help me be kind when someone new wants to play too.
Thank You for my friend ______.
Teach me to listen when a friend feels sad.
Bless the friends who live far away and the ones close by.
togetherLine: Lord, keep our friendships strong and true. Amen.

title: Bright Eyes, New Day
lines: Good morning, God! The sun is knocking on my window.
Thank You for birds singing before I even open my eyes.
Thank You for warm blankets and the smell of breakfast.
Fill my heart with giggles before I even get dressed.
Today I'm most excited about ______.
Help me hop out of bed with a happy heart.
Thank You for a brand new day to run and play.
togetherLine: God, fill this day with joy and light. Amen.

title: When the Day Feels Long
lines: Father, some days stretch out heavy and slow.
When my shoes feel too tight and my heart feels too full, stay near.
Help me breathe slow when everything goes wrong.
Thank You for a hug when the hard day is done.
Today felt hard because of ______.
Remind me tomorrow can start fresh and new.
You carry me even when I can't carry myself.
togetherLine: Lord, hold us close on the hard days too. Amen.

title: Making Us Whole Again
lines: Great Physician, You know every hurt we carry.
Thank You for doctors' hands and medicine that helps us grow well.
Be near to the ones who are sick tonight.
Mend the parts of us that ache deep inside.
Please help ______ feel better soon.
Thank You for bodies that heal, slow but sure.
You are the God who makes broken things new.
togetherLine: Jesus, heal us and hold us steady. Amen.

title: Saying Sorry, Feeling Free
lines: Lord, sorry is a small word that takes big courage.
Thank You for forgiving me even before I ask.
Help me say sorry when I've made someone sad.
Teach me to forgive quickly, like You forgive me.
I'm sorry for ______.
Wash away the grumpy feelings stuck inside my chest.
Thank You for hearts that can start over again.
togetherLine: God, help us forgive and be forgiven. Amen.

title: Moonlight Keeps Its Watch
lines: Lord, the blankets are pulled up tight now.
My eyes are heavy, my toys put away.
You do not sleep, so I don't have to worry.
Watch over ______ while we dream tonight.
Chase the shadows out of every corner.
Let my heart be still like a quiet pond.
Thank You for another day You gave me.
togetherLine: We rest in You tonight, Amen.

title: Boats and Planes for Jesus
lines: God of jungles and crowded cities,
Some tell Your story in languages I've never heard.
Bless the ones who left home to share Your love.
Keep ______ safe wherever they are serving.
Open hearts in places far from here.
Give courage to knock on strangers' doors.
Let Your good news travel like wind across water.
togetherLine: Send Your love around the whole world, Amen.

title: Solomon's Good Question
lines: Wise God, my brain is still growing,
Help me choose the right thing, not just the easy thing.
When I don't know the answer, whisper it to me.
Give ______ wisdom for today's tricky moment.
Teach me to listen before I speak.
Show me what matters more than being right.
Fill my thoughts with things that are true and good.
togetherLine: Make us wise like You are wise, Amen.

title: Kindness Like a Handshake
lines: Jesus, You noticed the little ones,
Help my words feel like a warm hug.
Let me share before someone has to ask.
Remind ______ to be gentle today.
Make my hands quick to help, not push.
Turn my grumbles into something gentler.
Let kindness be the first thing people see in me.
togetherLine: Make our hearts kind like Yours, Amen.

title: The Table Where We Gather
lines: Father, our home smells like supper cooking,
Thank You for this roof and these walls.
Bless the chairs where we sit together.
Watch over ______ when they come and go.
Let laughter bounce off every wall we have.
Keep our door open for those who need us.
Make this house a little piece of heaven.
togetherLine: Thank You for the home You've given us, Amen.

title: Fortress Around Our Beds
lines: Lord, You stand at every door tonight.
You circle our house like a strong wall.
When thunder cracks, You hold my hand.
No shadow scares You, not even one.
Keep watch over ______ as they sleep.
Your armor covers us from head to toe.
We rest because You never rest.
togetherLine: Lord, guard us close, and guard us well. Amen.

title: Pockets Full to Share
lines: God, You gave us hands to open wide.
Teach us to share our snacks and toys.
A coin, a smile, a piece of bread—
generosity starts with a willing heart.
Help ______ give without counting the cost.
Even small gifts can make someone smile.
Fill our pockets so we can pour them out.
togetherLine: Lord, make our hands as open as Yours. Amen.

title: Steady Feet on New Ground
lines: God of mountains, my knees feel wobbly today.
Courage isn't loud, but it walks forward.
When the diving board feels too high,
You are the steady ground beneath my feet.
Give ______ courage for what feels scary today.
Brave doesn't mean we're never afraid.
You go before us, so we can go too.
togetherLine: Lord, make us brave, one step at a time. Amen.

title: Sharing Swings and Secrets
lines: Jesus, You call us friends, not strangers.
Thank You for the ones who save me a seat.
Friends laugh at jokes that aren't even funny.
Help us be kind when someone feels left out.
Bless ______ and the friend they love most.
Some friends live close, some live far away.
Thank You for friendship that feels like home.
togetherLine: Lord, thank You for friends who stick close. Amen.

title: Birdsong and Bright Beginnings
lines: Good morning, Lord! The birds are already singing.
Joy jumps out of bed before I do.
Today is a gift wrapped in sunlight.
Help us smile before we even brush our teeth.
Fill ______ with joy for this brand new day.
Every morning is a fresh page to write.
We wake up loved, and that's enough.
togetherLine: Lord, thank You for joy that greets us each morning. Amen.

title: My Cup Is Full Here
lines: God, my toys are scattered but my heart feels calm.
I don't need one more thing to smile today.
Thank You for this spot right where I'm standing.
Help me stop wishing for what my friend has.
You already gave me ______, and that is plenty.
Teach me to breathe easy with just enough.
Quiet my grabbing hands, still my wanting heart.
togetherLine: We are happy, we are Yours, we are content. Amen.

title: Naming Every Kindness
lines: Look what You did again today, God!
I almost forgot to notice, but here it is.
Thank You for socks that match and bread that's warm.
Thank You for arms that hug me tight.
Today I'm especially thankful for ______.
Even small things came from Your big love.
Help my mouth say thanks before it grumbles.
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for every bit of good. Amen.

title: Growing Smarter Every Day
lines: Lord, my backpack is heavy but my brain wants more.
Numbers and letters can feel like a puzzle.
Give me patience when the answer hides from me.
Thank You for teachers who explain it twice.
Help me try hard even when ______ is tricky.
Let me be kind to the kid who's stuck too.
Fill my head with facts and my heart with wonder.
togetherLine: We will learn well, for You made our minds. Amen.

title: Handing You My Worries
lines: Father, my pillow is soft and my eyes are heavy.
The day is folding shut like a picture book.
I give You the wiggly thought about ______.
You don't sleep, so I finally can.
Keep the shadows in my room just shadows.
Watch my family breathing slow in the dark.
Wake us up new when morning comes again.
togetherLine: We rest in You tonight, safe and sure. Amen.

title: Sent Out With Love
lines: God of every language and every long road,
somewhere a stranger is telling someone about You.
Bless the ones who left home to go far away.
Give them courage when the words feel hard to find.
Please be near to ______ who serves You somewhere new.
Help hearts open like windows letting in light.
Use even us to send love out from here.
togetherLine: Go with Your people, Lord, to the whole wide world. Amen.

title: Suitcases and Sturdy Wings
lines: Jesus, our suitcases are packed and zipped tight,
Watch over the car, the train, or the plane,
Keep the driver's eyes sharp and steady,
Bless the roads and runways we travel today,
When we're far from home, help us still feel close to You,
I'm most excited to see ______,
Bring us safely to right where we're going.
togetherLine: Lord, hold our hands on every journey. Amen.

title: Slow Growing Trust
lines: Father, waiting feels like forever sometimes,
Help my foot stop tapping and my heart settle down,
Teach me to breathe slow like a summer breeze,
You are never in a hurry, so I don't have to be,
Give me kind words when I want to grumble,
Today I'm working on waiting for ______,
Turn my little sighs into songs of trust.
togetherLine: God, grow patience in us like a strong tree. Amen.

title: Leaves That Turn and Fall
lines: God of frost and blooming branches,
You turn the leaves from green to gold,
You wake the flowers when winter finally ends,
Snowflakes and sunshine both come from Your hand,
Every season tells us something true about You,
My favorite season is ______,
Thank You for painting the world again and again.
togetherLine: We praise You, Lord, in every season. Amen.

title: Held Tight Through Any Storm
lines: Lord Jesus, You see the storm before it comes,
Wrap our family in Your strong, quiet arms,
Keep danger far away from our door tonight,
Watch over us when we sleep and when we wake,
You are the shield we cannot see but always feel,
Please protect ______ in a special way today,
We are safe because You never look away.
togetherLine: Lord, keep us safe under Your care. Amen.

title: Give Until It's Joy
lines: Look at all we have, Lord—so much more than we need!
Show us who is waiting for a kind hand today,
Help us share our snacks, our toys, our time,
A giving heart grows bigger, never smaller,
Let us give with smiles, not sighs,
Today I want to share ______ with someone,
Make our family generous just like You are.
togetherLine: God, make our hands open and our hearts wide. Amen.

title: Quiet Settles Over Us
lines: Prince of Peace, the noise in my head gets loud sometimes.
Slow my breathing like a candle flame settling still.
Let peace sit on my shoulders like a soft blanket.
When my brother and I argue, help the storm pass quick.
Today I feel peaceful about ______.
Even when the news feels scary, You hold the whole world.
Fill this room with a calm only You can give.
togetherLine: Prince of Peace, rest in our home tonight. Amen.

title: Faces We Greet on Sunday
lines: Lord Jesus, our church doors creak open every week.
Thank You for the friends who wave from the third row.
Bless the pastor's voice when he tells us about You.
Thank You for ______ who teaches us at church.
Let our singing rise up like birds off a wire.
Keep our church family close when someone is hurting.
We belong here, stitched together by Your love.
togetherLine: Lord Jesus, thank You for this family of faith. Amen.

title: Arms That Always Open
lines: Father, our kitchen smells like supper and laughter.
Thank You for the ones who tuck me in at night.
I love how ______ makes our family laugh.
Even when we bicker, love finds its way back home.
Hugs feel like Your arms wrapped tight around us.
Keep our hearts kind when someone's feelings get hurt.
We are Yours, held together under one small roof.
togetherLine: Father, thank You for the love we share. Amen.

title: This Much Is Plenty
lines: God, my shoes are a little scuffed and that's okay.
I don't need a bigger toy box to feel glad.
Today I'm thankful just for ______, simple and small.
Help me stop wishing for what my friend has instead.
A full belly and a soft bed are treasure enough.
Teach my heart to rest instead of always wanting more.
You give exactly what today needs, nothing less.
togetherLine: God, this much is plenty—thank You. Amen.

title: Thank You Notes to Heaven
lines: Good and gracious God, my heart wants to say thanks out loud.
Thank You for crunchy leaves and rainy afternoons.
Thank You for ______, a gift I almost forgot to notice.
Thank You for hands that catch me when I trip.
Thank You for silly jokes that make the whole table laugh.
Thank You for another chance to try again tomorrow.
My whole heart says thank You, over and over.
togetherLine: Good and gracious God, thank You for everything. Amen.

title: Bandages Made of Love
lines: Jesus, some hearts around us feel cracked today,
we think of neighbors carrying heavy news.
Wrap Your arms around the ones who are crying,
sit close to anyone who feels alone tonight.
Help us notice the quiet hurt on a friend's face,
______ wants to pray for someone hurting right now.
Turn our small kindness into Your big comfort.
togetherLine: Lord, heal what's broken and hold us near. Amen.

title: Truth From a Small Mouth
lines: God, sometimes the true words feel hard to find,
we want our mouths to match our hearts.
Give us courage to say what really happened,
even when a small lie seems easier.
Help us trust that truth keeps us close to You,
______ promises to speak plainly and kindly today.
Thank You for loving us even when we mess up.
togetherLine: Make our words honest and our hearts light. Amen.

title: Blank Page, Bright Hope
lines: Father, You hand us a brand new morning,
no mistakes have been written on it yet.
We leave yesterday's stumbles behind us now,
and step into today with open hands.
Fill this new beginning with Your steady grace,
______ is ready to try something new today.
Thank You for chances that start right here.
togetherLine: We trust You with every new start. Amen.

title: Windows on the Move
lines: Lord of every mile marker and rest stop,
we buckle in and trust You with the road.
Watch over tires, wings, and tracks beneath us,
keep the driver's eyes clear and steady.
Let the miles pass with songs and giggles,
______ can't wait to see what's waiting ahead.
Bring us safely to wherever we are going.
togetherLine: Travel with us, Lord, mile after mile. Amen.

title: Slow Breaths, Steady Heart
lines: God, my fingers tap and my feet want to run,
waiting can feel like the longest minute ever.
Teach me to breathe slow when I want to rush,
and smile even when the line is long.
Help me wait kindly for my turn to come,
______ is practicing patience one breath at a time.
Thank You for staying patient with us always.
togetherLine: Slow our hearts down and grow our patience. Amen.

title: Busy Hands for You
lines: Lord, there's always someone who needs a hand,
show me the chore that's waiting to be done.
Let me carry what's heavy for someone else today.
Today I want to help ______.
Small jobs done with love make You smile, we believe.
Turn my "I don't want to" into "I'm glad to."
Use my hands like Yours, kind and quick to serve.
togetherLine: Together we serve, together we grow. Amen.

title: Confetti for Our God
lines: Hooray, Lord—today calls for cake and clapping!
You gave us this happy day to enjoy.
We twirl and shout because You are so good.
Thank You for the gift of ______.
Every good celebration starts with You, Father.
Let our joy spill over onto everyone nearby.
Balloons pop and hearts jump—we praise You loud!
togetherLine: Hooray for You, Lord, forever and ever! Amen.

title: Over the Backyard Fence
lines: God, our neighbors' porch light glows just like ours,
help us wave first and smile without waiting.
Teach us to share tools, cookies, and time.
Bless the family who lives near ______.
Let our street feel like one big family.
Give us courage to knock and say hello.
May kindness travel easy from yard to yard.
togetherLine: Lord, make us good neighbors today. Amen.

title: Still Air Around Me
lines: Father, some days my heart feels like a drum,
slow the beating, quiet the worried thoughts.
You are the calm that doesn't shake or shout.
Help me feel peaceful about ______.
Breathe Your steadiness into every corner of me.
Let peace pass from my hands to others' hands.
In the noisy moments, be my quiet place.
togetherLine: Peace be with us, peace within us. Amen.

title: Family Beyond Our Door
lines: Lord Jesus, we sing loud with people we love,
thank You for friends who pray alongside us.
Bless the ones who teach us and lead us well.
We're grateful for ______ at our church.
Grow us together like branches on one vine.
Let our church be a lighthouse for the lost.
Keep our hearts glad to gather every week.
togetherLine: We belong to You and to each other. Amen.

title: When the Sky Turns Gray
lines: God of every cloudy morning, today feels harder than most.
My backpack feels heavier and my smile takes more work.
You know the exact spot where it pinches, even when I can't explain it.
Help me breathe slow like a wave rolling back to sea.
Today I'm finding it tough to ______.
Sit with me until the gray patch moves on past.
Thank You for staying close when the day won't be easy.
togetherLine: Together we say: You hold our hard days too. Amen.

title: Mending Where It's Sore
lines: Great Physician, You know every scrape we can't quite see.
Some hurts are on our knees, some are tucked inside our chest.
Slow the ache down, the way ice cools a burn.
Give doctors and nurses steady hands and kind eyes today.
Please help this part of me get better: ______.
Even while we wait, remind us You are working quietly.
Turn our worried waiting into patient, hopeful trust.
togetherLine: Together we say: Make us whole, little by little. Amen.

title: Loosening the Knot
lines: Jesus, there's a knot in my chest from something I did wrong.
You untangle it so much easier than I ever could alone.
Help me say sorry without looking for an excuse to hide behind.
Soften the person I hurt, and soften me too.
Today I want to make things right about ______.
Thank You for wiping the slate clean, not just half-clean.
Teach my hands to forgive as quickly as they hold a hug.
togetherLine: Together we say: Untie the knots, Lord, and set us free. Amen.

title: Carrying a Candle Over
lines: Father of comfort, someone nearby is walking through a shadowy week.
We don't have to fix it to still show up beside them.
Let our little candle of kindness light their doorway tonight.
Nudge us to notice the friend who's gone quiet lately.
Today I want to check on ______.
Give us gentle words that don't rush them to feel better.
Wrap Your steady arms around whoever is struggling right now.
togetherLine: Together we say: Send comfort where it's needed most tonight. Amen.

title: Say It Straight
lines: God who never bends the truth, teach my tongue to match my heart.
It's tempting to shrink a story just to dodge trouble.
Give me courage for the moment right before I speak.
Let our home be a place where truth is always safe to land.
Today the honest thing I need to say is about ______.
Even when it's small, help me not slide around it.
Thank You for loving me steady, truth and all.
togetherLine: Together we say: Keep our words straight and our hearts open. Amen.

title: Compass for Small Feet
lines: God of quiet owls and open books,
Teach me to think before I leap.
Show me the answer under the noise.
When I don't know, whisper what's true.
Help me ask good questions today.
I want wisdom for my ______.
Grow patience in me like a slow-planted tree.
togetherLine: Lord, make us wise in small and big things. Amen.

title: A Warm Word Ready
lines: Jesus, You noticed the ones nobody saw,
Help my eyes find someone lonely today.
Put a warm word ready in my mouth.
Let my hands share what I don't need.
Soften the mean words before they land.
Today I will be kind to ______.
Make kindness my first, easy answer.
togetherLine: Lord, let kindness live in all we do. Amen.

title: Corners We Call Ours
lines: Father, this roof keeps the rain off our heads,
Thank You for the creaky floor and the loud front door.
Bless the table where we spill our stories.
Bless the bed where dreams get tucked in tight.
Let peace sit in every corner here.
I'm thankful for my ______ at home.
Keep this house soft for whoever knocks.
togetherLine: God, thank You for this home You gave us. Amen.

title: Someone's Helper Today
lines: Lord, You knelt down and washed dusty feet,
Show me a small job I can do.
Let me carry what's too heavy for someone else.
Help me notice a need before it's asked.
Turn my Saturday into someone's relief.
Today I want to help ______.
Make serving feel like breathing, not a chore.
togetherLine: God, use our hands to serve like Jesus served. Amen.

title: Dancing Down the Hallway
lines: God, today deserves balloons and loud singing,
Thank You for birthdays and Tuesdays that shine.
We clap because You are so good to us.
Every gift You give is worth a party.
Spin us around with joy today.
I'm celebrating ______ with my whole heart.
Let our laughter be a prayer of thanks.
togetherLine: Lord, we celebrate You today and always. Amen.

title: Standing Tall Today
lines: God of mountains and molehills, we come to You now,
My knees feel wobbly when something new is starting,
Give me courage like a shield strapped tight to my heart,
Help me take one small step even when I'm scared,
Today I need bravery for ______,
Remind me You are walking right beside me,
Turn my shaky "I can't" into a steady "I can."
togetherLine: Together we say: You are our courage, now and always. Amen.

title: Friends Who Stick Around
lines: Jesus, thank You for the friends who sit beside us,
Some days we laugh until our tummies hurt,
Some days we share our snacks and our secrets,
Teach us to be kind when a friend feels lonely,
Bless my friend named ______ today,
Help us forgive quickly when feelings get hurt,
Grow our friendships strong like roots in good soil.
togetherLine: Together we say: Thank You for friends who feel like family. Amen.

title: Wake Up Singing
lines: Good morning, God—the sun found us again!
Our eyes popped open and our hearts feel light,
Thank You for pillows and blankets and yawns,
Thank You for cereal bowls and busy mornings,
Fill today with joy for ______,
Help us skip instead of stomp through our day,
Let our smiles be the first gift we give.
togetherLine: Together we say: This is the day You made—we're glad in it! Amen.

title: When Nothing Goes Right
lines: Lord, today felt like a puzzle with missing pieces,
Nothing seemed to go the way we hoped,
Our voices got grumpy and our patience ran thin,
Come sit with us in this bumpy, tired place,
Help me let go of my frustration about ______,
Remind us tomorrow is a brand new try,
Hold our hearts steady until the hard part passes.
togetherLine: Together we say: Even on hard days, You never leave us. Amen.

title: Tender Care for Tender Hearts
lines: Great Healer, we bring You our scrapes and our sniffles,
Some hurts are on the outside, small and red,
Some hurts are hidden deep down in our hearts,
Wrap Your gentle care around every sore spot,
Please help healing come for ______,
Thank You for doctors, kisses, and quiet rest,
Grow strong and whole again, a little more each day.
togetherLine: Together we say: You are the God who heals us, inside and out. Amen.

title: Backpacks Full of Questions
lines: Lord Jesus, we carry backpacks full of questions today.
Thank You for teachers who explain things twice without sighing.
Help my mind stay curious even when the lesson gets hard.
Give me patience with letters and numbers that wiggle around.
Today I want to learn about ______.
Turn my mistakes into stepping stones, not stumbling blocks.
Fill our classroom with kindness and a little bit of laughter.
togetherLine: Lord, make our learning a gift we give back to You. Amen.

title: Pillows That Know Peace
lines: God of soft blankets, the day is folding shut around us.
My eyes are heavy, but my thoughts still spin in circles.
Take the worry off my pillow and hold it Yourself tonight.
Thank You for this bed, this roof, this quiet breathing room.
Watch over ______ while they drift into dreaming.
Let sleep come gentle, like a hand smoothing wrinkled sheets.
When morning comes, wake us rested and ready for You.
togetherLine: Lord, we trust You with the dark and the dawn. Amen.

title: Lanterns Carried Far
lines: God of every language, we think of those far from home tonight.
Bless the ones who packed light and traveled toward strangers.
Give courage to hearts sharing Your story in unfamiliar streets.
Protect the missionaries eating new foods and learning new words.
We pray for the people of ______ and the ways You love them.
Let churches rise in places we've never even seen on a map.
Remind us we're neighbors, even across oceans and borders.
togetherLine: Lord, send Your love to every corner of the earth. Amen.

title: Wisdom Bigger Than Me
lines: Father, You gave Solomon a wish and he asked for wisdom.
I want that kind of heart, one that chooses well.
Help me think before I speak and pause before I act.
Show me the difference between what's easy and what's right.
Grant wisdom to ______ when they face a hard choice.
Let me listen more than I talk, and learn more than I guess.
Fill our family with good sense and gentle understanding.
togetherLine: God, grow wisdom in us like roots grow deep. Amen.

title: Warm Hands, Warm Hearts
lines: Jesus, You noticed the tired and the tiny and the overlooked.
Teach us to notice too, right here in our own house.
Let kindness be our first response, not our last resort.
Help me share my snack, my smile, my seat, my time.
Today let ______ feel seen because of something kind we did.
Soften any grumpy edges before they turn into unkind words.
Make kindness as normal for us as breathing in and out.
togetherLine: Lord, let kindness follow us wherever we go today. Amen.

title: Maker of Falling Leaves
lines: God, You turned the green leaves gold and red,
You wake the sleepy flowers up each spring,
You send the snow to tuck the ground in tight,
You stretch the summer days out long and warm,
Today I noticed ______ and thought of You,
Every season is Your handiwork,
Thank You for the way You planned it all so well.
togetherLine: You made it all, and we say thank You—Amen.

title: Wrapped in Your Care
lines: Father, the night comes and You never blink,
You stand guard at every door we close,
You catch us when the sidewalk trips our feet,
You know the dark corners and light them up,
Keep ______ safe in all they do today,
No storm is bigger than Your steady hands,
We can rest because You never rest.
togetherLine: Lord, keep us close and keep us safe—Amen.

title: Sharing What We Hold
lines: Jesus, You fed a crowd with one boy's lunch,
You showed us that small gifts can grow so big,
Teach our hands to give before they grab,
Let us notice when a friend has none,
I want to share my ______ with someone today,
Generous hearts look a lot like Yours,
Help us give with joy and not a frown.
togetherLine: God, make our hands open and our hearts wide—Amen.

title: Courage for Small Giants
lines: Lord, David faced a giant with just five stones,
You gave him courage bigger than his size,
When my knees feel wobbly, remind me You are near,
Help me speak up when it's hard to speak,
Give ______ courage for the thing they're facing,
You go before us into every scary place,
With You beside us, we can take the next step.
togetherLine: God, make us brave because You're with us—Amen.

title: Friends Who Feel Like Family
lines: God of laughter and long afternoons,
Thank You for friends who sit with me at lunch,
Thank You for the ones who share their toys,
Thank You for friends who forgive and stay,
I'm grateful for ______ and the fun we share,
Help me be a good friend back to them,
Friendship is a gift You planned from the start.
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for the friends You gave us—Amen.

title: Our Little Circle Grows
lines: Father, You stitched our family together like a quilt,
each patch a person You love just the same.
Thank You for hugs that squeeze away the grumpy,
and hands that hold ours when we're scared.
Bless ______, and the way they make our house brighter.
Help us be kind even when we bump heads,
and remind us love isn't loud, it's steady.
togetherLine: We are Yours, and we are each other's, forever. Amen.

title: Full Hearts, Simple Days
lines: God of quiet afternoons and ordinary Tuesdays,
thank You that today has enough in it.
We don't need more toys to feel rich,
or a bigger house to feel warm.
Teach ______ to smile at what's already here,
and let us stop wishing for someone else's day.
Our little life is small but it is full, and that is plenty.
togetherLine: Right here, right now, we are content in You. Amen.

title: Grateful Hearts Tonight
lines: Lord, we could count a hundred gifts before breakfast,
warm socks, silly jokes, and the smell of toast.
Thank You for eyes that see color and ears that hear music,
for friends who wave first and pets who greet us at the door.
______ is thankful for something special today,
and we want to notice the small gifts, not just the big ones.
Even ordinary days are wrapped in Your kindness.
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for more than we can count. Amen.

title: Books, Numbers, and You
lines: Jesus, You grew in wisdom just like we do,
line by line, question by question, day by day.
Help us try even when the math is tricky,
and listen well when someone else is talking.
Give ______ courage to raise a hand and ask,
thank You for teachers who help us understand,
and for brains that get stronger every time we use them.
togetherLine: Fill our minds with wonder and our hearts with patience. Amen.

title: Held Until Morning
lines: Lord, the lamps are dimming and our eyes grow heavy,
thank You for walls that keep the wind outside.
We give You the worries that followed us to bed,
and the happy parts of today too.
Watch over ______ while they dream tonight,
keep our hearts calm like a still, dark lake,
and wake us up ready for whatever comes next.
togetherLine: We rest in You, safe until morning light. Amen.

title: New Buds on Old Branches
lines: Lord, the calendar turns and something in us turns too,
You make new starts feel possible again.
Wash away yesterday's stumbles and give us today.
Help ______ try something brand new without fear.
Thank You for second chances wrapped like gifts.
Grow courage in us like a small green shoot.
We step into this new day holding Your hand.
togetherLine: New beginnings are Yours, and so are we. Amen.

title: Buckled In and Blessed
lines: Jesus, wheels are turning and the road stretches far,
Watch the car, the plane, the train we ride today.
Keep the driver's eyes sharp and steady.
Bless every stop and every mile between.
Let ______ feel safe buckled in beside us.
Guide us past the bumps and around the storms.
Bring us home again, tired but together.
togetherLine: Every road we travel, You travel too. Amen.

title: Waiting Like a Seed
lines: God, some things grow slow, like seeds beneath the dirt,
Teach us to wait without stomping our feet.
Help ______ breathe deep when waiting feels too long.
Turn our sighs into little prayers instead.
Remind us good things often take their time.
Soften our grumbles into gentle patience.
Grow steady hearts that trust Your timing.
togetherLine: We will wait, Lord, and trust You still. Amen.

title: Every Season Wears Your Signature
lines: Maker of frost and maker of sun,
You paint winter white and summer gold.
Every season carries Your handwriting somewhere.
Thank You for rain that wakes the flowers.
Let ______ notice one wonder outside today.
You never run out of new colors to try.
We praise You in every kind of weather.
togetherLine: Every season sings that You are good. Amen.

title: Walls Only You Can Build
lines: Father, some walls are made of bricks, and some are made of You,
Stand guard around our home tonight.
Keep watch over ______ while they sleep and while they play.
Turn away the things that frighten us.
Hold our hearts steady when the world feels loud.
You are stronger than every shadow we imagine.
Wrap us safe inside Your care.
togetherLine: No harm can reach us while You hold us near. Amen.

title: The Yard Beside Ours
lines: Lord Jesus, You called the man next door our neighbor,
so help us wave and smile and mean it,
thank You for the ______ who lives beside us,
teach us to share a cup of sugar or a kind word,
let our porch light welcome those who pass,
make us quick to help and slow to judge,
grow love right over every fence we know.
togetherLine: We will love our neighbors like You love us. Amen.

title: Still Inside My Chest
lines: God of the calm sea and the quieted storm,
still the noisy worries bouncing in our heads,
when ______ feels shaky, hold that heart steady,
breathe Your peace into every corner of this home,
let our voices soften when tempers rise,
help us choose kindness instead of the last word,
rest Your peace like a blanket over us tonight.
togetherLine: Peace be with us, and peace we will share. Amen.

title: Voices That Sing Beside Us
lines: Father, we walk through doors filled with familiar faces,
thank You for the hands that teach us Your Word,
bless ______ who greets us with a hug each Sunday,
thank You for the songs we sing all together,
grow our church like a garden full of every color,
help us welcome anyone who walks through the door,
knit our hearts to this family of faith.
togetherLine: We are glad to belong to Your church. Amen.

title: Arms Wrapped Around Us All
lines: God of every hug and every bedtime story,
thank You for the love that fills this kitchen table,
thank You that ______ makes our family brighter,
help us forgive quickly when feelings get bruised,
teach our hands to help without being asked,
let laughter echo louder than any argument,
bind us together with a love that never breaks.
togetherLine: We love because You first loved us. Amen.

title: Glad for What We Hold
lines: Father, some days we want more toys, more everything,
teach us to smile at what is already ours,
thank You for ______, a gift we sometimes forget,
help us stop comparing and start thanking,
show us joy in simple, ordinary things,
quiet the wanting that grows too loud inside,
fill our hearts until they feel full and glad.
togetherLine: We are content, for You are enough. Amen.

title: Chalk Dust and Clean Slates
lines: Jesus, my fist was tight with anger today,
show me how to loosen my grip and let it go.
When someone says sorry, help me really listen.
When I mess up, give me brave words to say sorry too.
Wipe our arguments away like chalk from a board.
______ needs my forgiveness, and I want to give it freely.
Make our hearts light again, ready to play and laugh.
togetherLine: Together we say: Clean slate, fresh start, forgiven together. Amen.

title: Soup for a Sad Neighbor
lines: God, some hearts are heavy today, even if they smile,
help us notice the tears hiding behind quiet eyes.
Give us warm soup and warmer hugs to share.
Teach us to sit close when words run out.
Heal the ache in bodies that feel tired and sore.
We pray right now for ______, who needs Your comfort.
Use our small hands to carry Your big love.
togetherLine: Together we say: Comfort them, Lord, and use us too. Amen.

title: No Crossed Fingers Here
lines: Father, it's easy to shrink the truth when it's scary,
but You made our mouths for words that are true.
Help me tell it straight, even when my cheeks turn pink.
Give me courage when a fib feels easier to say.
Let my yes mean yes and my no mean no.
Today I want to be honest about ______, even if it's hard.
Thank You for loving me, truth and all.
togetherLine: Together we say: Straight words, honest hearts, always. Amen.

title: New Shoes, New Steps
lines: Lord, something new is starting, and my tummy feels fluttery,
thank You for fresh starts that wipe the old worries away.
Walk beside me on this ground I haven't walked before.
Turn my nervous feet into steps of quiet courage.
What was broken, You are making brand new again.
I'm starting ______ today, and I trust You'll be there.
Fill this new beginning with Your steady, good plans.
togetherLine: Together we say: New day, new step, You go with us. Amen.

title: Zipped Bags, Ready Hearts
lines: God of every road and runway, we are packed and ready,
watch over wheels and wings as we travel far.
Keep the driver's hands steady and the pilot's eyes clear.
Turn long hours in the car into songs and giggles.
Bring us safely to where we're going, and safely home again.
On this trip, please watch over ______ especially.
Thank You for adventures waiting just down the road.
togetherLine: Together we say: Keep us safe, wherever we roam. Amen.

title: Roof Over Our Giggles
lines: Thank You, God, for the floor where we tumble and play.
Thank You for the kitchen that smells like something good.
Thank You for my bed with its soft, cozy blanket.
Thank You for the door that always lets us back in.
Thank You for the window where the sunlight sneaks through.
Today I'm thankful for ______ in our home.
Bless every corner where our family laughs and rests.
togetherLine: Fill this home with You, we pray, Amen.

title: Small Jobs, Big Kindness
lines: Jesus, You knelt down and washed dirty feet,
show us small jobs that make someone smile.
Help me carry a bag or open a door.
Let my hands share what my heart already knows.
Show us someone who needs a kind word today.
Today I want to help ______ with something they need.
Turn our looking into doing, our caring into giving.
togetherLine: Use our hands, Lord, to serve like You, Amen.

title: Cake and Clapping Hands
lines: Hooray! Something wonderful is happening today,
thank You for laughter that bubbles over.
Thank You for friends who clap when we succeed.
Thank You for songs that make our feet move.
Thank You for treats that taste like joy.
Today we celebrate ______ with grateful hearts.
Every good moment is a gift from You.
togetherLine: We shout our thanks with joy, Amen.

title: The Street Where We Live
lines: God, so many people live close to our door,
help us learn their names and wave hello.
Thank You for the ones who mow, wave, and smile.
Help me share a treat with someone nearby.
Teach us to notice when a neighbor needs help.
I want to be kind to ______ who lives near us.
Make our street a place where kindness travels fast.
togetherLine: Help us love the ones close by, Amen.

title: Peace Like a Blanket
lines: Prince of Peace, the world feels loud and fast,
slow my breathing, quiet my busy mind.
Help me feel calm when voices are shouting.
Let peace sit with me like a soft blanket.
When worries buzz, remind me You are near.
Give ______ a peaceful heart today.
Still the storm inside me, Lord, and stay close.
togetherLine: Fill us with Your peace tonight, Amen.

title: Golden Crumbs of Morning
lines: Look, the sun found our window again!
Our toes wiggle awake before we do.
Birds outside are practicing their good news.
Thank You for cereal and sleepy hugs.
Today I want to smile at ______.
Fill our morning with little sparks of laughter.
Help us carry this joy out the front door.
togetherLine: Together we say: Thank You, God, for a brand new day. Amen.

title: When My Backpack Feels Full
lines: Father, my shoulders are heavy today.
The math didn't work and my words got stuck.
Even grown-ups have days that feel gray.
You saw every hard minute, Lord.
Sit close to ______ when things go wrong.
Turn our sighs into small, quiet prayers.
Tomorrow is still waiting, fresh and new.
togetherLine: Together we whisper: Carry us through, dear Lord. Amen.

title: Strong Again, Little by Little
lines: Jesus, You touched the sick and they stood up.
Our bodies get tired, achy, and small.
Thank You for doctors with careful hands.
Thank You for medicine that helps us mend.
Wrap ______ in Your warm, healing light.
Give us patience while we get better.
You are strong even when we feel weak.
togetherLine: Together we pray: Heal us, Lord, day by day. Amen.

title: Clean Slate, Open Arms
lines: Lord, I said something sharp today.
My heart still feels a little prickly.
You forgive us more than seventy times seven.
Help me say sorry with my whole heart.
Help me forgive ______ when they mess up too.
Take the prickly feeling and make it soft.
Friendship is worth more than being right.
togetherLine: Together we say: Forgive us, and help us forgive. Amen.

title: Carrying Names in Prayer
lines: God, some houses have empty chairs tonight.
Some friends are crying where we cannot see.
Some tummies are hungry in far off places.
You know every name we cannot name.
Send comfort to ______ and all who are hurting.
Use our hands to help however we can.
No sad heart is too small for You.
togetherLine: Together we pray: Be near to the hurting, Lord. Amen.

title: Faraway Friends We've Never Met
lines: God of jungles and cities and snow,
You know every name in every land,
bless the ones who packed their bags for You,
teaching, healing, telling Your good news,
keep them safe when the road gets rough,
help me pray for ______ far away today,
grow Your love in every corner of the earth.
togetherLine: Lord, send love to every faraway place. Amen.

title: Choosing Right Over Easy
lines: Lord, sometimes the easy choice isn't the right one,
give me a mind that stops and thinks first,
show me what's true when friends say "just do it,"
help me listen more than I talk,
teach me to ask before I decide,
give wisdom to ______ when choices feel hard,
make me steady like a tree with deep roots.
togetherLine: God, grow wisdom in us like a strong tree. Amen.

title: Little Kindness, Big Ripple
lines: Jesus, one small smile can change a whole day,
help me notice who is sitting alone,
give me words that lift instead of sting,
let me share my snack, my turn, my toy,
help me say something nice when it's hard,
bless ______ with kindness from someone today,
make my hands quick to help, not hurt.
togetherLine: Lord, let kindness ripple out from us today. Amen.

title: Where Our Story Lives
lines: Father, the kitchen smells like supper again,
thank You for the doormat that welcomes us home,
thank You for the creaky stair we all know,
thank You for the couch where we pile up close,
bless every corner where we play and rest,
thank You for the smell of ______'s favorite meal,
keep this house full of love and light.
togetherLine: God, thank You for the home You've given us. Amen.

title: Eager Hands, Willing Hearts
lines: Lord Jesus, You never walked past someone in need,
teach me to notice who needs a hand,
help me carry, share, and give without grumbling,
make me quick to say "let me help,"
use my strength for someone else's day,
show me how to help ______ this week,
let serving others feel like serving You.
togetherLine: Jesus, use our hands to serve like You did. Amen.

title: Hands That Give Away
lines: God, my piggy bank jingles with coins to share,
Help me notice when a friend has none,
Teach me to give without counting the cost,
Let my toys move to someone else's shelf sometimes,
