Today I want to give my ______ away with joy,
Make my heart feel bigger, not smaller, when I share,
Show me one kind thing to give before the sun sets.
togetherLine: Lord, make our hands open and our hearts glad to give. Amen.

title: Steady Heart, Brave Steps
lines: Lord Jesus, my knees feel wobbly like jelly,
Sit close when the dark or the new feels big,
Help me try the thing that scares me a little,
Remind me You are stronger than my shaking hands,
Today give me courage for my ______,
Turn my whisper of fear into a steady breath,
Walk beside me even on the hardest steps.
togetherLine: Jesus, be our courage when our knees want to shake. Amen.

title: Friends Who Share My Snacks
lines: Father, thank You for the kid who saves me a seat,
Thank You for laughing so hard at silly jokes,
Bless the friend who shares half a cookie with me,
Help me be kind even when I'm not first picked,
Today I'm thankful for my friend ______,
Teach me to be a good friend, not just have one,
Grow our friendships strong like roots underground.
togetherLine: God, thank You for the friends who make our days brighter. Amen.

title: Sunbeams on the Pillow
lines: God, my blanket is warm and the morning is new,
Thank You for eyes that open to another day,
Fill my yawns with wiggles and my heart with song,
Let joy bounce out of me before breakfast is done,
Today I'm excited about ______,
Paint this whole day with Your happy colors,
Help me hop out of bed with a grin.
togetherLine: God, thank You for this fresh, joyful morning. Amen.

title: When the Puzzle Won't Fit
lines: Father, today felt like a shoe with a stone inside,
Nothing lined up the way I wanted it to,
Sit with me when my plans fall apart,
Help me breathe slow when frustration creeps in,
Today my hard part was ______,
Remind me tomorrow gets to start clean and new,
Hold my hand until this heavy feeling lifts.
togetherLine: Lord, carry us through today and give us rest tonight. Amen.

title: Jar Full of Little Joys
lines: Father, my heart feels like a jar catching little joys today.
Thank You for the crunch of toast and the smell of rain.
Thank You for laughter that sneaks up during dinner.
Thank You for ______, a gift I almost forgot to notice.
Thank You for socks that match and days that don't.
Thank You for the people who call this house home.
Fill our jar, Lord, until it overflows with thanks.
togetherLine: We are thankful, we are thankful, amen.

title: Chalkboards and Curious Hearts
lines: Lord Jesus, my brain feels like a sponge today, ready to soak up new things.
Help me listen when my teacher explains something tricky.
Help me try again when my letters wiggle out of order.
Thank You for books that open like doors to faraway worlds.
Give me patience with ______, the subject that twists my brain.
Help me be kind to the friend who is still learning too.
Make my mind sharp and my heart even kinder.
togetherLine: Teach us, Lord, and we will learn, amen.

title: Trusting You Till Morning
lines: Jesus, the lamp is dim and my eyes are heavy now.
I give You the worry that followed me up the stairs.
I give You the mistake I made before dinner.
Watch over ______, who is sleeping somewhere else tonight.
Watch over the whole family curled up in this house.
Let my dreams be soft and my breathing slow.
I trust You to hold the dark until the sun comes back.
togetherLine: We rest in You tonight, amen.

title: Feet That Carry Good News
lines: God of every language and every shore, hear our small prayer.
Bless the ones who packed their bags to tell Your story.
Bless the ones learning new words just to say Your name.
Watch over ______, who serves You in a place we've never seen.
Give courage to missionaries eating unfamiliar food tonight.
Let Your love travel faster than any airplane.
Use our hands here to help their hands over there.
togetherLine: Go with them, Lord, we pray, amen.

title: Wisdom Like a Lamp
lines: Father, some choices feel like a maze with no exit sometimes.
Give me wisdom bigger than my own little ideas.
Help me think before my mouth says something foolish.
Show me the wise way when ______ feels confusing.
Let me ask for help instead of guessing alone.
Make me wise like the stars that know their path.
Fill my head with sense and my heart with patience.
togetherLine: Lord, make us wise today, amen.

title: Waiting for the Kettle to Boil
lines: Lord, the line at the store feels so long today.
Teach me to breathe slow when I want to rush.
Help me wait like a seed under warm soil.
When my brother takes forever, soften my huff.
Slow down my stomping feet and my tapping toes.
Today I will practice waiting for ______.
Thank You for staying patient with me every single day.
togetherLine: Lord, grow patience in us like a quiet garden. Amen.

title: Frost and Fireflies Together
lines: Maker of maple trees and melting snow, we praise You.
You painted autumn leaves the color of fire.
You wake the crocus up beneath the frost.
Summer bugs hum and winter stars shine bright.
Every season carries Your fingerprints somewhere.
My favorite season to spot You in is ______.
Thank You for turning the earth so gently.
togetherLine: Lord of every season, we see You everywhere. Amen.

title: Watchman Over Our Doorway
lines: God, You stand guard at our front door tonight.
No shadow is stronger than Your steady hand.
Wrap our windows and walls in Your peace.
When thunder cracks, remind us You are near.
Keep watch over ______ as they sleep tonight.
Angels line up quietly along our hallway.
We rest easy knowing You never nod off.
togetherLine: Lord, keep us safe beneath Your steady care. Amen.

title: Spilling Over With Kindness
lines: Jesus, my hands feel full of things to share.
Teach me to give without counting the cost.
A cookie split in half tastes twice as sweet.
Let my toys find new friends to play with.
Show me who is missing a warm coat today.
I want to give my ______ to someone who needs it.
Make our family a fountain, not a locked box.
togetherLine: Lord, make our hands open and our hearts wide. Amen.

title: Standing Firm When Scared
lines: God of lions and lightning, give me strength today.
When the diving board looks too high, hold my hand.
Fear whispers loud but Your voice is louder still.
Help me raise my hand even when I'm nervous.
Give me courage to say sorry first.
Today I need brave feet for ______.
You go before me like a lamp in fog.
togetherLine: Lord, make us brave, one small step at a time. Amen.

title: Bells That Call Us In
lines: God of the steeple and the songs we sing,
thank You for doors that open wide for us.
Thank You for friends who wave and say hello.
We like the bread and the cup we share.
We like the stories our teachers tell us.
At church I feel close to ______.
Bless every person who welcomes us in.
togetherLine: Together we say: We are glad to belong. Amen.

title: Our Noisy Lovely Nest
lines: Father, our house is loud with laughing and love,
thank You for arms that hug me tight.
Thank You for hands that tuck me in at night.
We share our toys and our silliest jokes.
Even when we bicker, we still forgive each other.
I am extra thankful today for ______.
Help us be gentle when someone feels sad.
togetherLine: Together we say: Our family is a gift from You. Amen.

title: No Need to Chase More
lines: Lord, my toys are enough for today,
I don't need the shiny thing next door.
My bed is soft, my belly is full.
I won't compare my stuff to someone else's.
Simple things can make me smile today.
Right now I'm happy with ______.
Teach my heart to rest in what I have.
togetherLine: Together we say: We are content in You, Lord. Amen.

title: Small Things, Big Thanks
lines: Thank You, God, for the crunch of morning toast,
thank You for the puddle I splashed in today.
Thank You for a friend who shared their crayons.
Thank You for the birds singing outside my window.
Thank You for a hug when I felt low.
Today I am especially thankful for ______.
Help me notice every little gift You give.
togetherLine: Together we say: Thank You for this good day. Amen.

title: Letters, Numbers, Light
lines: God of ABCs and wobbly first tries,
thank You for teachers who help us grow.
Thank You for books that open new worlds.
Help me be patient when the answer is hard.
Help me be kind to my classmates today.
I'm excited to learn about ______.
Fill my mind with curiosity and courage.
togetherLine: Together we say: We are ready to learn today. Amen.

title: Clear Eyes, Honest Words
lines: Lord, my mouth feels quick to shade the truth sometimes.
Give me courage when the true answer feels hard.
Help me say what's real, even when it's small.
Let ______ know I'll always tell them straight.
Teach us to trust each other's honest words.
Keep our family safe with truth between us.
Make our "yes" mean yes, our "no" mean no.
togetherLine: Lord, make our hearts as clear as our words. Amen.

title: Beginning Again With You
lines: God of morning light and second chances,
Thank You for days that start clean and new.
When yesterday was hard, help me try again.
Give ______ courage for something they're starting.
You make old things new in Your gentle way.
Help us not be scared of what's unfamiliar.
Walk with us into whatever comes next.
togetherLine: God, thank You for fresh starts every single day. Amen.

title: Every Mile You Know
lines: Jesus, the road ahead is long and winding today.
Watch over our wheels and our wandering path.
Keep us patient when the ride feels bumpy.
Bless ______ as we travel together somewhere new.
Thank You for knowing every mile before we go.
Bring us safely to the place we're headed.
Let this trip be full of laughter, not worry.
togetherLine: Lord, You know every road we travel. Amen.

title: Learning to Wait Well
lines: Father, waiting stretches long when I want things now.
Teach my heart to slow down and breathe.
Help me wait kindly, without grumbling or rushing.
Give ______ patience when things take longer today.
You are never in a hurry, Lord, so help me trust.
Let me find peace in the space between.
Grow patience in me like a slow, strong tree.
togetherLine: Lord, teach us to wait with peaceful hearts. Amen.

title: Seasons Spun by Your Hand
lines: What a wonder, Lord, how the world keeps changing!
You paint the trees gold and then wrap them in snow.
Every season carries Your fingerprints somewhere.
Thank You for warm days and cool ones too.
Show ______ something beautiful outside today.
You never stop making the earth new again.
We praise You for spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
togetherLine: Lord of every season, we praise Your wonders. Amen.

title: Balloons for Your Goodness
lines: Ring out the bells, today is a gift, Lord!
We clap our hands for birthdays and bright surprises.
You turn ordinary days into little parties.
Thank You for cake, for songs, for silly dancing.
Today I'm celebrating ______ with a happy heart.
Every good gift comes tumbling down from You.
Fill our home with laughter and shining eyes.
togetherLine: Together we shout: hooray for You, our joyful God! Amen.

title: Waving Over the Hedge
lines: Father, our street is full of people You love.
Teach us to wave, to smile, to say hello.
Help us notice the ones who feel forgotten.
Let our porch light welcome tired neighbors home.
Today I want to be kind to ______.
Give us soup to share and doors that open.
Make us the kind of family that shows up.
togetherLine: Together we pray: help us love our neighbors well. Amen.

title: Quiet Like Falling Snow
lines: Jesus, calm the noisy corners of my mind.
Let peace fall soft like snow upon our home.
When voices rise, help us breathe and listen slow.
You are the quiet at the center of every storm.
Right now I hand You my worry about ______.
Still our hearts like a lake without a ripple.
Wrap us in Your peace that makes no sense.
togetherLine: Together we rest in Your peace tonight. Amen.

title: Voices Under One Roof
lines: God of every pew and every open hymn book,
we love the place where we sing Your name together.
Thank You for friends who pray beside us there.
Bless the hands that teach us, welcome us, feed us.
Help me be kind to ______ when we gather.
Grow our church like a garden full of light.
May we carry Sunday joy through all our week.
togetherLine: Together we say: we're glad to belong here. Amen.

title: Stitched Into One Story
lines: How good it is, Lord, to belong to each other!
You wove our family with threads of laughter and grace.
Thank You for hugs that fit just right.
Even when we squabble, love finds its way back.
Today I'm thankful for ______ and their kind heart.
Teach us patience when tempers run quick and hot.
Let our home be a shelter built on love.
togetherLine: Together we say: we love each other because You loved us first. Amen.

title: Warmth for Every Owwie
lines: Jesus, You touched the sick and they stood tall,
Breathe Your kindness on my sore knee,
Mend the cough that keeps me up,
Heal the ache inside my ______,
Comfort every hospital bed tonight,
Make tired bodies strong again,
Thank You for doctors' careful hands,
togetherLine: Lord, make us well, make us whole, Amen.

title: Soften My Stubborn Sorry
lines: Lord Jesus, I said something sharp today,
Wash the grumble out of my chest,
Help me say sorry and mean it,
Teach me to forgive my ______ too,
Erase the score I keep in my head,
Fill the gap with a hug instead,
Thank You for loving me first,
togetherLine: Forgive us, Lord, and help us forgive, Amen.

title: Neighbors Who Carry Sorrow
lines: God of every quiet tear,
See the ones who cry alone tonight,
Send someone kind to sit with them,
Wrap the sad family down the road,
Give me words when someone's hurting near,
Let my ______ be a gift to share,
Hold the lonely close to You,
togetherLine: Lord, comfort every hurting heart tonight, Amen.

title: Straight Talk, Kind Hearts
lines: Father, my tongue can twist the truth,
Give me courage to say what's real,
Help me not to hide the broken cup,
Let my yes be yes, my no be no,
Guard me from little sneaky lies,
Make my ______ match what really happened,
Thank You for truth that sets me free,
togetherLine: Lord, keep our words honest and true, Amen.

title: Seeds We Plant Today
lines: How wonderful, Lord, that today is new!
Wipe yesterday's mess from my heart,
Plant fresh hope where I felt stuck,
Help me try the hard thing again,
Grow something good from my mistakes,
Let my ______ start again with You,
Walk with me into this new season,
togetherLine: Lord, thank You for beginnings, Amen.

title: Kindness in Small Coins
lines: Jesus, kindness is a coin I can spend today,
let me give it fast, before I even think twice.
Help me notice when someone needs a smile.
Teach me to share my snack, my seat, my turn.
Today I want to be kind to ______.
Make my hands gentle and my words soft.
Grow kindness in me like a seed in warm dirt.
togetherLine: Lord, make us kind, today and every day. Amen.

title: This Roof, These Walls
lines: Father, this house holds all our noise and naps,
thank You for the table where we eat together.
Thank You for my bed and my favorite blanket.
Bless the door that opens when we come home.
I'm thankful this week for ______ in our house.
Keep our home safe and full of laughter.
Let peace live in every room we share.
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for this home You gave us. Amen.

title: Ready When You Call
lines: Lord, show me a job my small hands can do,
maybe carrying, maybe cleaning, maybe just listening well.
Help me serve without waiting to be asked.
Let me help ______ with something today.
Make my heart glad to give my time away.
Teach me that serving is like following You.
Use my hands to make someone's day lighter.
togetherLine: Lord, help us serve with willing hearts. Amen.

title: Streamers for This Day
lines: What a happy noise we get to make, Lord!
Thank You for birthdays, and cake, and silly songs.
Thank You for good news that makes us jump.
Today we celebrate ______ with clapping hands.
Fill our house with laughter and bright colors.
Every good gift comes down from You.
Let us clap and dance because You are good.
togetherLine: We celebrate You, Lord, with joyful hearts. Amen.

title: Over the Garden Wall
lines: God of the houses lined up on our street,
help me wave and smile at those nearby.
Show me a neighbor who might need a friend.
Let me share a cookie or a kind word.
Today I want to bless ______ next door.
Teach us to love the people close to home.
Make us quick to help, slow to ignore.
togetherLine: Lord, help us love our neighbors well. Amen.

title: Buddies Who Cheer Me On
lines: Jesus, thank You for the friend who waves first,
for the one who saves me a seat,
for laughing until our sides hurt,
for sharing snacks and secrets too,
today I want to be a good friend to ______,
help me listen more than I talk,
thank You for friends who feel like sunshine.
togetherLine: We thank You, Jesus, for the friends You give us. Amen.

title: Waking Up to Wonder
lines: Father, the morning light is knocking on my window,
birds are singing before I even open my eyes,
thank You for a brand new morning,
thank You for breakfast and warm hugs,
today I'm excited about ______,
fill my heart with giggles and glad songs,
help me carry this joy all day long.
togetherLine: Lord, we welcome this joyful morning. Amen.

title: When My Heart Feels Small
lines: Lord Jesus, today felt like climbing a steep hill,
my heart felt tight and my eyes felt hot,
thank You for staying close when things go wrong,
help me breathe slow and remember You're near,
today was hard because of ______,
wrap Your strong arms around my worried heart,
tomorrow is a new chance to try again.
togetherLine: Jesus, hold us close on our hardest days. Amen.

title: Soft Places to Heal
lines: God of gentle hands, my body needs Your care,
thank You for doctors, medicine, and rest,
thank You for hugs that make hurts feel smaller,
please heal the ache inside ______,
help patience grow while my body gets stronger,
thank You for nights that help me mend,
You are the God who makes broken things whole.
togetherLine: God, we trust You to heal us. Amen.

title: Sweeping Away My Sorry
lines: Father, I carried a grumpy feeling all day,
I said words that stung like nettles,
help me say sorry with a soft, brave voice,
help me forgive ______ the way You forgive me,
wash the mad feelings out of my chest,
thank You for hugs that fix what's broken,
tomorrow I want to start fresh and kind.
togetherLine: Lord, teach us to forgive like You do. Amen.

title: Night Falls, You Stay
lines: Lord, the stars are punching holes in the dark,
and You are awake behind every one.
My blanket is heavy, my eyes are heavy too,
so I hand You my worries before I close them.
Watch over ______ while they dream tonight,
and watch over me curled up small and safe.
Nothing can slip past Your steady, open eyes.
togetherLine: We rest in You tonight, Lord Jesus. Amen.

title: Ships and Small Letters
lines: Father, somewhere a plane is landing with good news,
and someone steps off carrying Your Word like bread.
Bless the missionary who left home to find new neighbors,
and the children learning Your name in a different tongue.
Keep ______ safe wherever they carry Your love,
and open doors that seemed shut tight before.
Let the whole round earth hear how much You care.
togetherLine: Send Your love around the world, Lord. Amen.

title: A Map for My Mind
lines: God of quiet answers, my head is full of questions.
Give me wisdom bigger than a test I have to pass.
Help me choose the good way, not just the fast way,
and know the difference when nobody is watching.
Whisper to ______ when the choice feels hard,
and steady my hands before I decide.
You gave a king wisdom when he asked—so hear me too.
togetherLine: Fill our minds with Your wisdom, Lord. Amen.

title: Warm Bread for Someone
lines: Jesus, my hands can carry more than toys,
they can carry a smile or a plate of something warm.
Show me the kid who is sitting alone today,
and give me the nerve to sit down beside them.
Let ______ find a kind word to give away,
even when it costs a little bit of pride.
Kindness is small, Lord, but it never runs out.
togetherLine: Make our hands kind today, Jesus. Amen.

title: Walls That Hum With Us
lines: Father, our kitchen smells like something good cooking,
and the floor creaks with all our running feet.
Thank You for this roof that keeps the rain off,
and these walls that have heard our silly songs.
Bless ______ who makes this house feel like home,
and bless the door that always opens wide.
Let peace live here in every corner and hallway.
togetherLine: Thank You for this home You've given us. Amen.

title: Wrapped Safe Tonight
lines: God of towers and strong gates, You stand watch by our door.
We tuck our fears beneath Your wing and rest upon the floor.
Keep the shadows soft and small, keep the noises kind.
Watch our window, watch our roof, watch each sleepy mind.
When I'm scared of dark corners, Lord, be the light I find.
Protect ______ in a special way tonight, Lord.
Hold our whole house steady till the morning comes.
togetherLine: You are our shield, You are our peace, Amen.

title: Open Palms for Others
lines: Lord, my piggy bank jingles with coins to share.
Teach me to give without counting the cost.
Let my snack be enough for two if someone's lunch is lost.
Show me who needs a hug, a hand, or a helping smile.
Make my heart like a cup that pours out all the while.
______ wants to give something away today, Lord.
Turn our small gifts into big joy for someone new.
togetherLine: Make us generous, Lord, just like You, Amen.

title: Strong Like a Cedar
lines: Father, my knees wobble before the big jump.
Give me courage like a lion, not a mouse in a lump.
When the diving board feels tall, remind me You are near.
When new kids stare, help me smile instead of fear.
Brave isn't feeling strong, it's trusting You today.
______ needs courage for something hard, Lord, help them stay.
Walk beside me into the scary, unknown place.
togetherLine: You go before us, we are brave, Amen.

title: Playground Full of Grace
lines: Jesus, thank You for the giggles on the swings.
Thank You for the friend who shares her crayons and her things.
Bless the buddy who saves me a seat at lunch.
Help me be kind to the one nobody picks for the bunch.
Friends are Your gift, wrapped in laughter and in play.
______ has a friend they're thankful for today.
Teach us to forgive quick and to play fair and free.
togetherLine: Thank You for friends, thank You for love, Amen.

title: Toes on the Cool Floor
lines: What a gift, another morning to unwrap!
My toes touch the cool floor and my heart says yay.
Birds are singing louder than my alarm today.
Breakfast smells like cinnamon and something new to try.
Thank You for waking me with the sun in the sky.
______ feels excited about something today, Lord.
Fill this whole day with wonder, laughter, and Your light.
togetherLine: Good morning, Lord, we're glad You're here, Amen.

title: Content With This Moment
lines: Lord, I don't need more toys to feel glad,
A warm bowl of soup can make my whole day,
I don't have to have the fastest bike or the tallest tower,
You gave me ______, and that is enough,
Help me smile at what I already hold,
Teach me to rest instead of reaching for more,
Your love fills the empty spaces in me.
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, You are enough for us. Amen.

title: Counting Today's Gifts
lines: Father, my heart is a basket today,
Thank You for the crunch of morning toast,
Thank You for hands that wave hello,
Thank You for ______, a gift just for me,
Thank You for rain that waters the garden,
Thank You for songs that make us laugh,
Every little thing is a present from You.
togetherLine: Together we say: Thank You, God, for it all. Amen.

title: Ready to Learn Today
lines: God of new questions, my backpack is packed,
Fill my mind with wonder for numbers and words,
Help my pencil move with patient, careful lines,
When I don't understand ______, give me courage to ask,
Let me be kind to the friend who sits beside me,
Guide my teacher's voice with wisdom today,
Thank You for a brain that grows a little more.
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, teach us as we learn. Amen.

title: Safe Until Morning Comes
lines: Jesus, the lamp is off and the house is quiet,
My blanket is warm and my pillow is soft,
You never sleep, so I don't have to worry,
Watch over ______ while we dream tonight,
Chase away the shadows that creep by my door,
Hold my heart steady until the sun returns,
I close my eyes safe in Your hands.
togetherLine: Together we say: Jesus, we trust You through the night. Amen.

title: Prayers That Cross Oceans
lines: Lord of every language, tonight we think of friends we've never met,
Bless the teachers sharing Your story in far off classrooms,
Bless the doctors bandaging wounds in dusty villages,
Watch over ______ serving You in another country,
Help hungry hearts everywhere find Your bread of life,
Carry Your good news over mountains and seas,
Make our small prayers grow big in Your hands.
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, send Your love around the world. Amen.

title: Tires Hum a Quiet Song
lines: Lord Jesus, the road stretches out ahead of us,
You know every mile before we drive it.
Keep our wheels steady and our eyes awake.
Bless the driver's hands and the map we follow.
Watch over ______ as we travel today.
Bring us safely to where we're going.
Thank You for adventures waiting at the end.
togetherLine: Wherever we roam, Lord, You roam with us. Amen.

title: Honey Pours Slow and Sweet
lines: God of steady hands, teach me to wait without fussing.
The line is long and my feet want to dance away.
Help me breathe slow when the answer isn't yet.
Give ______ a calm heart when waiting feels hard.
Turn my sighs into songs while I wait for You.
Some things grow best when they're not rushed.
Thank You for waiting with me, every single time.
togetherLine: Slow and steady, we trust Your timing. Amen.

title: Frost, Bloom, and Falling Gold
lines: Look at the world You built for us, Lord of falling leaves.
Snow melts and green shoots peek up through the mud.
Summer sun warms the tops of our heads.
Autumn wind spins the leaves like tiny dancers.
Show ______ something new outside today.
Every season carries Your fingerprints, Father.
We turn like the earth, always toward Your light.
togetherLine: Maker of seasons, we praise You in every one. Amen.

title: Circle of Your Strong Care
lines: Father, the night presses close against our windows,
but You are closer still, wide awake beside us.
Nothing sneaks past Your watching eyes.
Guard our doors and guard our dreams tonight.
Keep ______ safe wherever they lay their head.
When thunder rumbles, remind us You are bigger.
We rest inside the circle of Your strong care.
togetherLine: You never sleep, so we can. Amen.

title: More When We Give It Away
lines: Jesus, my hands were made for holding, but also for giving.
Show me the neighbor who needs an extra share.
Letting go feels hard, but You make it lighter.
Turn my small gift into someone's big smile.
Help ______ find one thing to give away today.
We never run dry when we pour out for others.
Make our family known for open, giving hands.
togetherLine: The more we give, the more we find. Amen.

title: Peace That Finds My Corners
lines: Jesus, my thoughts feel like a shaken jar of snow,
still my mind until the flakes fall slow.
Breathe peace into the tight place in my chest,
quiet the worry so my heart can rest.
Today ______ needs Your calm to settle in,
help us speak softly, not shout or spin.
Let peace sit with us like a friend who stays.
togetherLine: Prince of Peace, calm us now and always. Amen.

title: Bells Ring Us Together
lines: Lord, the doors swing wide, the choir warms up,
friends wave hello with a hug and a cup.
Thank You for teachers who tell us Your Word,
for songs that rise like birds that have stirred.
______ loves sitting close in our favorite pew,
bless our pastor and the work he must do.
Grow our church like a garden, wild and true.
togetherLine: We are Your church, together we grow. Amen.

title: Hearts Tangled Up Together
lines: Father, our hearts got tangled up together,
like roots that grow no matter the weather.
Thank You for hugs that squeeze extra tight,
for bedtime stories and the porch light.
______ makes our family laugh out loud,
we're a strange, wonderful, wiggly crowd.
Keep us close even when we disagree.
togetherLine: Bind our hearts together in love. Amen.

title: Satisfied With Simple Things
lines: Lord, I have a blanket, a bowl, a friend nearby,
that's enough to make me smile, not sigh.
I don't need the shiniest toy on the shelf,
just Your love, my family, and myself.
______ is grateful for the small and plain,
help us not grumble or complain.
Teach our hearts to rest in what we've got.
togetherLine: Lord, You are enough, we want no more. Amen.

title: Gifts Tucked Into Today
lines: God, You tucked good gifts inside today,
sunshine, snacks, and time to play.
Thank You for the socks that keep toes warm,
for shelter safe from wind and storm.
______ says thanks for something small and sweet,
for laughter, hugs, and muddy feet.
Fill our mouths with thank-you every day.
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for everything You give. Amen.

title: Someone Feels Alone Tonight
lines: God who sees every tear, look at the ones who are hurting today.
Wrap the sad and lonely in your warm light.
Send someone kind to sit close beside them.
Let ______ feel less alone because we prayed.
Heal the aches that don't show on the outside.
Steady the hands of doctors and helpers.
Open our eyes to notice a hurting friend.
togetherLine: Lord, hold every hurting heart tonight. Amen.

title: Let My Word Be Solid
lines: Father, make my words match what is real.
Help me tell the truth even when it's hard.
Give me courage to admit my mistakes out loud.
Let ______ trust what comes from my mouth.
Keep my yes a yes and my no a no.
Guard me from little lies that grow big.
Thank you for friends who tell me the truth in love.
togetherLine: Lord, keep our words honest and kind. Amen.

title: The Next Step Forward
lines: God who makes all things new, thank you for today.
You turn old endings into fresh starts.
Give us courage to try the thing we haven't tried.
Let ______ step into something new with joy.
Wash away yesterday's mistakes and mess.
Fill our hands with hope for what's ahead.
Walk with us into whatever comes next.
togetherLine: Lord, thank you for new beginnings. Amen.

title: Safe Travels, Steady Hearts
lines: Lord of every road and runway, watch over our trip.
Keep the driver's eyes sharp and steady.
Guard the wheels, the wings, and the way.
Let ______ feel calm when the journey gets long.
Bring us safely to where we are going.
Thank you for new sights along the way.
Bring us home again when the traveling is done.
togetherLine: Jesus, keep us safe on every mile. Amen.

title: Teach My Heart to Wait
lines: Lord, the waiting feels so long today.
Help me breathe slow instead of stomping my feet.
Teach me that good things grow in their own time.
Let ______ practice patience with a gentle heart.
Quiet the hurry that jumps up inside me.
Help me be kind while I wait my turn.
Thank you for staying patient with me too.
togetherLine: Lord, grow patience in us today. Amen.

title: Willing Feet, Kind Deeds
lines: Jesus, You knelt down and washed dusty feet.
Teach our hands to serve like that today.
Show me someone who needs a helper.
Let me carry, share, or lend a hand.
Today I want to help with ______.
Serving You means loving people close by.
Make our whole family ready and willing.
togetherLine: Lord, make us glad to serve others today. Amen.

title: Ribbons and Rejoicing
lines: Clap your hands—our God has done great things!
We shout for joy and spin around the room.
Thank You for birthdays, hugs, and happy songs.
Thank You for cake and balloons and laughter loud.
Today we celebrate ______ with grateful hearts.
Every good gift comes down from You above.
Let our joy rise up like music to the sky.
togetherLine: God, we celebrate You with all our hearts. Amen.

title: Front Porch Blessings
lines: Father, our street holds so many open doors.
Help us wave and smile at who lives near.
Teach us to notice the neighbor who's alone.
Give us courage to bring soup or a smile.
Today help me be kind to ______ nearby.
You made us to love the people close to home.
Let our porch light shine for someone else.
togetherLine: Lord, help us love our neighbors well. Amen.

title: Calm Waters Within
lines: God of quiet, calm the noise inside me.
When my heart feels loud, You are still near.
Help us breathe slow and let worry go.
Bring peace to arguments and hearts that hurt.
Give ______ Your peace when things feel hard.
You are the calm beneath every storm we face.
Let peace sit with us like a gentle friend.
togetherLine: Jesus, fill our home with Your peace. Amen.

title: Family of Believers
lines: Lord, thank You for the church that welcomes us.
We sing together and learn about Your love.
Thank You for friends who pray by our side.
Bless the people who teach us and lead us.
Today I'm thankful for ______ at our church.
Grow us together like a family of faith.
Let our church be a light on the hill.
togetherLine: God, thank You for our church family. Amen.

title: When the Ground Feels Bumpy
lines: God of every bump in the road, today felt hard.
Something scratched at my patience and I felt it sting.
Thank You for staying close when my face turned grumpy.
Help me breathe slow when the hard part comes back.
Today the hard thing was ______.
Give me one small smile to carry into tomorrow.
You are strong enough to hold my whole hard day.
togetherLine: Lord, hold us steady when the day feels hard. Amen.

title: Where Broken Places Mend
lines: Great Physician, You know every ache we carry.
Touch the sore spot, the scraped knee, the tired heart.
Mend what's broken slow, one gentle day at a time.
Thank You for doctors, bandages, and soup that helps us rest.
The place that needs Your healing today is ______.
Wrap us up until the hurting starts to fade.
You are the one who makes weak places strong again.
togetherLine: Jesus, heal us and hold us close. Amen.

title: When Sorry Meets Grace
lines: Merciful Father, my heart feels heavy with what I did wrong.
Thank You for washing the guilt away like rain on dust.
Help me say sorry with my whole heart, not just my mouth.
Teach me to forgive the way You forgive me first.
The person I need to forgive or ask forgiveness from is ______.
Take the heavy feeling and give me light instead.
Your grace is bigger than every mistake I make.
togetherLine: Lord, forgive us and help us forgive others. Amen.

title: For Hearts That Ache Nearby
lines: Compassionate God, someone near us is struggling today.
Open our eyes to see the ones who feel forgotten.
Give us kind words when someone's heart is breaking.
Let our hugs feel like Your arms wrapped around them.
The person I'm praying for right now is ______.
Show us a small way to help carry their sadness.
You never leave the hurting ones alone, not ever.
togetherLine: God, comfort everyone who is hurting today. Amen.

title: Truth Held in Small Hands
lines: Faithful God, let my mouth tell only what is true.
Keep me far from little lies that feel easy to tell.
Give me courage to speak plain even when it's hard.
Thank You for trust that grows when we are honest.
The truth I need to tell today is ______.
Help me listen for truth and hold it carefully.
You are truth itself, and I want to be like You.
togetherLine: Lord, make us people who always tell the truth. Amen.

title: Whisper Wisdom While I Grow
lines: Lord, my mind is like a garden, still learning what to grow.
Teach me to listen before I speak.
Show me the right path when two roads look the same.
Fill my questions with your quiet answers.
Help me choose kind over quick.
Today I want to grow wiser in ______.
Guide my choices, big and small.
togetherLine: God of wisdom, teach us to think with your heart. Amen.

title: Kindness Tucked in My Pocket
lines: Jesus, put a kind word in my pocket for later.
Help me notice who needs a smile today.
Let my hands be gentle, even when I'm cross.
Turn my sharp words into soft ones.
Show me one small kindness to give away.
Today I want to be kind to ______.
Make kindness my first choice, not my last.
togetherLine: Lord, grow kindness in us like seeds in soil. Amen.

title: This Kitchen Holds Us All
lines: God of every room in this house, thank you for the noise and the quiet.
Bless the table where we eat and talk.
Thank you for the bed that holds my dreams.
Keep our doorway open to love.
Let laughter fill the hallway again tomorrow.
I'm thankful our home has room for ______.
Watch over every corner while we sleep.
togetherLine: Father, thank you for this home you've given us. Amen.

title: Hands That Reach Beyond Us
lines: Lord Jesus, you never walked past someone in need.
Open my eyes to see who's lonely.
Give me hands ready to carry, lift, and help.
Let my feet walk toward the one who's hurting.
Teach me that serving is never too small.
Today I want to help ______.
Use our family to share your love outside these walls.
togetherLine: God, send us out to serve like Jesus served. Amen.

title: Joyful Noise Today
lines: Hooray! Today is a day to celebrate you, God!
Thank you for birthdays, hugs, and happy surprises.
Let our laughter rise up like a song.
Clap for the good things you've done in our lives.
Dance a little—joy is allowed today!
I'm celebrating ______ with a happy heart.
Fill this day with smiles and thankful shouts.
togetherLine: God of joy, we celebrate you today and always. Amen.

title: Fearless Feet Forward
lines: Jesus, my knees feel wobbly but You are strong beside me.
Give me courage like a spark that lights the dark.
When I'm scared to try something new, hold my hand tight.
Help me speak up kindly even when my voice shakes.
Today I want to be brave about ______.
Turn my fear into a fire that helps me shine.
Thank You for walking every scary step with me.
togetherLine: We are brave because You are with us, Amen.

title: Friends Who Fill My Days
lines: Father, thank You for friends who laugh at my silly jokes.
Bless the friend who shares their swing and their snack.
Help me be kind even when someone is different from me.
Thank You for ______, who always makes me smile.
Teach me to listen when a friend feels sad.
Let our friendship grow like a garden You planted.
Thank You for friends who stick close through every storm.
togetherLine: Thank You, God, for friends who feel like sunshine, Amen.

title: Sunlight Spills Through Windows
lines: Good morning, God! The sun is peeking through my window.
Thank You for a new day with fresh things to discover.
Fill my heart with giggles before breakfast even starts.
Help me hop out of bed with a happy heart.
Today I'm excited about ______.
Let joy bubble up like juice fizzing in a cup.
Thank You for birds singing just outside my door.
togetherLine: This is the day You made—let's be glad in it, Amen.

title: Carrying Heavy Backpacks
lines: Lord, today felt like carrying a backpack too heavy for me.
When things go wrong, remind me You are still good.
Help me breathe slow when my heart feels tight.
Thank You for arms that hug me when I cry.
Today was hard because of ______.
Help me trust that tomorrow can feel lighter.
Wrap Your peace around me like a warm blanket.
togetherLine: Even on hard days, You never let go of us, Amen.

title: Soothing Every Sore Spot
lines: Great Healer, my body feels tired and sore today.
Thank You for doctors and nurses who help me feel better.
Touch the place that hurts with Your gentle hand.
Help my heart heal when feelings get hurt too.
Please help ______ feel better soon.
Thank You for rest that helps me grow strong again.
You are the God who makes broken things whole.
togetherLine: Thank You, Jesus, for healing us inside and out, Amen.

title: Ready Minds, Open Books
lines: Father, thank You for the desk where I sit and learn.
Fill my mind with wonder for letters, numbers, and maps.
Help me listen when my teacher explains something new.
When a problem feels tricky, give me patience to try again.
Today I want to learn about ______.
Thank You for friends who sit beside me and share their crayons.
Make my hands steady and my heart eager to grow smarter.
togetherLine: Lord, guide our minds and hearts as we learn together today. Amen.

title: Drifting Safe Into Dreams
lines: Lord Jesus, the lamps are dim and my eyes are heavy.
You watched over the moon and stars before I was born.
Wrap our house in Your quiet, steady care tonight.
Even if I wake in the dark, You are already awake with me.
Tonight I give You my worry about ______.
Let our breathing slow and our hearts feel light.
Thank You for this soft bed and this safe roof.
togetherLine: We rest in Your hands tonight, Lord, safe until the sun comes up. Amen.

title: Seeds Sent to Far Fields
lines: God of every nation, we think of friends we've never met.
Bless the ones who carry Your story on planes and long roads.
Give them strong feet, kind words, and courage to keep going.
Watch over the children in villages we can only imagine.
We pray today for missionaries serving in ______.
Let Your love reach kitchens, huts, and city streets alike.
Use our small prayers to help plant seeds far away.
togetherLine: Lord, grow Your love in every corner of the earth. Amen.

title: Light for My Thinking
lines: Wise God, my head is full of questions today.
Teach me to choose words that build up instead of tear down.
When I don't know what's right, whisper the answer to my heart.
Help me ask for help instead of guessing alone.
Give me wisdom when I decide about ______.
Let me learn from my mistakes instead of hiding them.
Grow me to be thoughtful, patient, and true.
togetherLine: Lord, fill our family with wisdom that shines like a light. Amen.

title: Gentle Words We Give Away
lines: Gracious Father, put kindness right where my hands can reach it.
Help me notice when someone nearby feels forgotten.
Let a smile or a helping hand be my first response.
Soften my words even when I feel grumpy inside.
Today I want to be kind to ______.
Show me small ways to share what I have.
Thank You for kindness that comes back around to us.
togetherLine: Lord, let kindness flow from our family to everyone we meet. Amen.

title: Orchards of Your Making
lines: Maker of maple leaves and morning frost, we praise you today.
You painted pumpkins orange and summer skies so blue.
Every little acorn holds a tree you already dreamed.
Thank you for wind that spins the weathervane round.
My favorite thing you made this season is ______.
You never run out of colors to try.
Keep our eyes wide open for wonders past our window.
togetherLine: Maker of every season, we thank you together. Amen.

title: Held By Steady Arms
lines: Strong God, you stand watch at every door of our house.
When thunder cracks, your voice is louder still.
You count each hair upon our heads, every single one.
No shadow is too dark for your light to find.
Tonight I give you my worry about ______.
Your hand is bigger than any storm we know.
We rest tonight because you never fall asleep.
togetherLine: Guard us close, Lord, and keep us safe. Amen.

title: Sharing Like Sunshine
lines: Father, you fill our cup so we can pour it out.
You gave us bread enough to break and share.
A gift feels bigger when both hands let go.
Show us who might need what we have today.
This week I want to give away ______.
Nothing we hold was ever ours to keep alone.
Make our hearts light like windows thrown open.
togetherLine: Lord, teach us to give like you gave to us. Amen.

title: Strong Enough to Try
lines: Lord, when my hands shake, you hold them steady.
You walked through fire beside friends who trusted you.
Fear knocks at my door but you answer for me.
Give me courage bigger than my worry today.
Help me be brave about ______.
One small step forward is still walking with you.
You are the strength living inside my chest.
togetherLine: Be our courage, Lord, today and always. Amen.

title: Together on the Playground
lines: God of laughter, thank you for the friends beside me.
You made us to need each other's hugs and help.
Thank you for someone who shares their crayons with me.
Friends make hard days feel a little lighter.
Today I'm thankful for my friend ______.
Teach us to be kind even when we disagree.
Bind our hearts together like a strong rope.
togetherLine: Thank you, God, for the friends you've given us. Amen.

title: Woven Around This Table
lines: Father, we gather close like puzzle pieces fitting right.
Thank You for the hug that says I'm glad you're home.
Thank You for the giggles bouncing off these walls.
Bless the hands that cook and the hands that clean.
Help us listen when someone's day was hard.
Today I am thankful for ______ in my family.
Knit our hearts a little closer every single day.
togetherLine: Together, as one family, we love like You first loved us. Amen.

title: Happy Right Where I Stand
lines: Gentle God, my toys are enough and my table is full.
Teach me not to want my neighbor's shiny new thing.
This small room feels big enough for all my joy.
Thank You for shoes that fit and a bed that's mine.
Help me smile at what I have instead of what I don't.
Right now, I am happy with my ______.
Quiet my wishing heart and fill it with peace instead.
togetherLine: Together we say: this much is more than enough. Amen.

title: Grateful for the Small Stuff
lines: Oh thank You, God, for warm socks and Saturday mornings!
Thank You for crunchy leaves and sticky popsicle summers.
Thank You for grandma's voice on the phone.
Thank You for the dog that wags when I walk in.
Thank You for silly songs we sing in the car.
Today I want to thank You especially for ______.
Fill my mouth with thank-you words all day long.
togetherLine: Together we shout: thank You, God, for everything! Amen.

title: Sharpened Pencils, Sharp Minds
lines: Wonderful Teacher, sharpen my mind like a brand new pencil.
Help me raise my hand even when I feel shy.
Thank You for letters that turn into stories I love.
Give me patience when the math problem feels tricky.
Help me be kind to the new kid at recess.
Today I hope to learn more about ______.
Grow my brain and grow my heart at the very same time.
togetherLine: Together we learn, together we grow, all for You. Amen.

title: Sleepy Eyes, Safe Hearts
lines: Quiet Shepherd, the stars are out and my eyes are closing.
Thank You for this soft pillow and this warm blanket.
Chase away the shadows that make my heart jump.
I give You my worries before I fall asleep.
Watch over my family while we all dream tonight.
Tonight I trust You with my ______.
Wrap us in Your peace until the morning light.
togetherLine: Together we rest, safe in Your hands tonight. Amen.

title: Green Shoots and New Starts
lines: God of morning light and open doors,
thank You for today, so shiny and new.
Help me try again when yesterday was hard.
Give me courage to start something fresh.
Today I want to grow in ______.
Thank You for second chances You give so freely.
Make my heart ready for what's ahead.
togetherLine: Together: Lord, make us new today. Amen.

title: Wheels That Carry Us
lines: Lord of every road and runway,
keep our wheels steady and our hearts calm.
Bless the driver, the pilot, the path we take.
Watch over us when we are far from home.
Help me be patient in the back seat.
I'm thankful for ______ waiting at the end of this trip.
Bring us safely to where we need to be.
togetherLine: Together: Guide us, Lord, on every mile. Amen.

title: Slow and Steady Trust
lines: Father, waiting feels so hard sometimes,
but You are never in a hurry with love.
Help me breathe slow when I want to rush.
Teach me to smile while I wait my turn.
I want to practice patience with ______ today.
Thank You for staying close while I wait.
Grow my heart to trust Your perfect timing.
togetherLine: Together: Lord, help us wait with joy. Amen.

title: Garden of Shifting Colors
lines: Creator of every falling leaf and blooming branch,
we see Your hand in every season's turn.
Thank You for sunshine, snow, and gentle rain.
You paint the sky with colors we can't make.
My favorite thing about this season is ______.
Help us notice the wonder You've hidden outside.
Every tree and flower whispers of Your care.
togetherLine: Together: We praise You, Maker of all seasons. Amen.

title: Guardian of Every Step
lines: Mighty God, You never sleep nor slumber,
so we can rest without any fear.
Guard our home when the night grows dark.
Keep watch over us at school and at play.
Protect the people I love, especially ______.
Surround our family with Your strong, quiet care.
We trust You to keep us safe today and tonight.
togetherLine: Together: You are our safety, Lord. Amen.

title: Knocking on Kindness
lines: Lord Jesus, you told us to love the ones next door,
Help me wave and smile when I see them outside,
Bless the family who lives right beside our home,
Show us how to share a plate of warm cookies,
Today I want to be kind to ______,
Give us open hands when a neighbor needs help,
Thank you for every face we know on our street,
togetherLine: Together we pray: Lord, make us good neighbors today, Amen.

title: Whispers of Calm
lines: God of quiet mornings, calm the noise inside me,
When my thoughts feel loud, whisper your peace to me,
Slow my breathing when the day feels rushed,
Help our home stay gentle when tempers rise,
Give ______ a peaceful heart today,
Still the worries that buzz around my head,
Let your calm settle over us like soft falling snow,
togetherLine: Together we say: Prince of Peace, rest in our hearts, Amen.

title: One Body, Many Hands
lines: Father, we thank you for the church that welcomes us in,
Bless the teachers who share your Word with us each week,
Thank you for friends who sit beside us and sing,
Help us serve alongside the hands that serve with us,
Today I pray for ______ from our church family,
Grow our love for the people who worship with us,
Use our church to shine your light on our town,
togetherLine: Together we pray: Lord, build your church through us, Amen.

title: Love That Wraps Us Close
lines: Father, your love holds our family together like a warm quilt,
Thank you for the ones who tuck me in at night,
Bless the laughter that fills our kitchen table,
Help us forgive quickly when feelings get hurt,
Today I'm thankful for ______ in our family,
Teach us to hug a little longer and argue a little less,
Knit our hearts together with threads only you can weave,
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, thank you for our family's love, Amen.

title: Full Without More
lines: Lord, teach my heart to rest without wanting more,
Thank you for the toys and treasures I already have,
Help me smile even when my plate isn't full of extras,
Quiet the "I want" voice that grows loud inside me,
Today I am grateful for ______ right where I am,
Show me joy in ordinary, simple things,
Fill my heart until it has no room for envy,
togetherLine: Together we pray: Lord, you are enough for us, Amen.

title: When Sorry Feels Sticky
lines: Lord Jesus, sorry gets stuck in my throat like peanut butter,
Help me swallow my pride and say the words out loud.
Wash the mad feeling out of my chest like rain on a window.
Give me a soft heart when someone says sorry to me too.
Today I forgive ______ for the thing that bugged me.
Make our house a place where sorry always finds a home.
Thank You for forgiving me first, over and over again.
togetherLine: Forgiven and free, we say it together — Amen.

title: Candles for Cloudy Hearts
lines: God of gentle whispers, some friends are having a cloudy day,
Help me notice the frown before it turns into tears.
Give me words that feel like a blanket, not a bandage.
Show me how to sit close when someone doesn't want to talk.
Today I'm praying for ______ who is having a hard week.
Turn cloudy hearts to sunshine in Your own good time.
Use my hands to carry a little light to someone sad.
togetherLine: Shine through us for hearts that hurt today — Amen.

title: Truth Without a Twist
lines: Faithful God, sometimes a fib feels easier than the truth,
Straighten my words before they leave my mouth all crooked.
Give me courage to say what really happened, even when it's hard.
Help me trust that truth is safer than any clever cover-up.
Today I'll tell the truth about ______, even if it's tricky.
Thank You for a family who loves me when I mess up.
Make my yes mean yes and my no mean no.
togetherLine: Straight and true, that's how we want to be — Amen.

title: New Ground, New Grace
lines: Creator God, yesterday is finished and today is brand new,
Thank You for mornings that wipe the chalkboard clean.
Help me leave old mistakes folded up behind me.
Plant fresh courage where nervous feelings used to grow.
This new season, I'm most excited about ______.
Walk beside me onto ground I've never stood on before.
You make all things new, even ordinary Tuesdays.
togetherLine: New starts, new grace, we step out with You — Amen.

title: Highways Held in Your Hand
lines: Faithful Guide, our car is packed and the road stretches far,
Keep the wheels steady and the tired eyes awake.
Watch over pilots, drivers, and every stranger we pass.
Turn long hours in the backseat into songs and giggles.
Keep ______ safe on the whole way there and back.
Bring us safely to the place You're leading us.
Thank You for adventures waiting at the end of the road.
togetherLine: Every mile, every mile, You're driving with us — Amen.

title: Every Corner Feels Like You
lines: Father, this house hums with our footsteps and laughter,
thank you for the roof that keeps the rain off our heads,
thank you for the table where we spill our stories,
bless the door that welcomes us home each evening,
today ______ is thankful for a favorite cozy spot,
fill every room with kindness when we forget to share,
let this home be a shelter for anyone who needs one.
togetherLine: Together we say: thank you for this home, Amen.

title: Hearts That Lend a Hand
lines: Lord Jesus, you knelt down to wash tired feet,
teach us to notice when someone needs help,
give us hands that carry, hearts that give,
show us the neighbor who needs a smile today,
______ wants to help someone in a small way this week,
let us serve without waiting to be asked,
make our small acts feel like your big love.
togetherLine: Together we say: use our hands today, Amen.

title: Sparklers of Praise
lines: Hooray! Today is a day to celebrate with you, God,
thank you for birthdays, and hugs, and happy news,
thank you for songs that make our feet dance,
we clap our hands because you are so good,
______ is celebrating something special today,
let our joy spill over onto everyone we meet,
thank you for the reason we get to smile.
togetherLine: Together we shout: we celebrate you, Amen.

title: Loving the Ones Nearby
lines: God, you placed us right where we live for a reason,
thank you for the people who share our street,
help us wave hello and mean it with our hearts,
show us how to be kind to the ones close by,
______ wants to be a good neighbor this week,
let our porch light be a sign of welcome,
help us love the people we see every day.
togetherLine: Together we say: help us love our neighbors, Amen.

title: Peace Like Falling Feathers
lines: Gentle God, some days feel loud inside my head,
settle my thoughts like feathers drifting down slow,
quiet the worry that tugs at my heart,
remind me your peace is bigger than my fears,
______ needs your peace to rest in tonight,
breathe calm into every corner of our home,
let peace float gently over all we do.
togetherLine: Together we whisper: fill us with your peace, Amen.

title: Yawns Turn to Laughter
lines: Good morning, God—the sun is climbing up to say hello,
Birds are singing songs they learned before we woke,
Thank you for my bed, my blankets, and this brand-new day,
Fill my heart with giggles before I even brush my teeth,
Help me hop out of bed with joy instead of grumbles,
Today ______ wants to smile at everyone they meet,
Let our whole house wake up humming with your happiness.
togetherLine: We shout for joy—this day is a gift from you! Amen.

title: Gritty Days, Gentle God
lines: Lord, some days feel like walking uphill with rocks in my shoes,
Nothing goes the way I planned and my patience runs thin,
You know how heavy my heart gets when everything's hard,
Be my strength when I want to sit down and quit,
Remind me tomorrow can start fresh, even after today,
Right now ______ is carrying something tricky too,
Hold our hands, God, until the hard part passes.
togetherLine: You never let go of us, even on the hardest days. Amen.

title: Mending Under Your Hand
lines: Great Physician, you know every ache before we say it out loud,
Send your healing warmth into the places that hurt,
Mend what's broken, inside and out, gently and true,
Thank you for doctors, medicine, and rest that helps us grow strong,
Wrap your comfort around anyone who feels weak today,
Please help ______ feel better a little more each day,
Turn our tears into strength as you make us whole.
togetherLine: You are the healer of every hurt—we trust you fully. Amen.

title: The Sorry That Sets Free
lines: Father, sometimes I do the thing I promised I wouldn't do,
My sorry feels small next to how big my mistake was,
Thank you for washing away the guilt I carry,
Teach me to forgive as fast as you forgive me,
Help me say sorry with my whole heart, not just my mouth,
I want to make things right with ______ today,
Turn our arguments into hugs and our grudges into grace.
togetherLine: Forgiven and free, we start again together. Amen.

title: Reaching Toward the Hurting
lines: God of comfort, some hearts around us are breaking quietly,
Some families are scared, some friends are sick or sad,
Help us notice when someone needs a kind word,
Give us soft hands and open ears for those who ache,
Send your peace to people who feel forgotten tonight,
We especially pray for ______ and the hard thing they're facing,
Use our family to bring a little light to someone's dark day.
togetherLine: Lord, hold every hurting heart close to yours. Amen.

title: Every Corner of the Earth
lines: God of every nation, we lift missionaries to you now.
Bless the ones who leave their homes to share your love.
Give them courage when the language feels unfamiliar.
Watch over families sleeping in far-off houses tonight.
Help us remember them even when we are busy.
Today ______ wants to pray for someone we've never met.
Let your good news travel to every corner of the earth.
togetherLine: Lord, use us to carry your love around the world. Amen.

title: Teach My Mind to Listen
lines: Lord, my brain is full of questions today.
Help me pause before I speak too fast.
Show me the difference between clever and wise.
Give me patience when the answer isn't easy.
Let me learn from grown-ups who love you.
______ needs your wisdom for a choice this week.
Fill our thoughts with what is good and true.
togetherLine: God, make us wise in all we say and do. Amen.

title: A Smile to Share Today
lines: Jesus, put kindness right at the tip of my tongue.
Help me notice when someone is left out.
Give me a smile to share with a stranger today.
Teach my hands to help without being asked.
Soften my words when someone bothers me.
______ will practice kindness with a friend today.
Let our whole family be known for being kind.
togetherLine: Lord, make kindness our first response always. Amen.

title: Where Our Hearts Live
lines: Thank you, God, for the walls that keep us warm.
Thank you for the table where we share our food.
Bless the small rooms where we laugh and rest.
Keep peace inside every doorway of this place.
Thank you for the people who sleep under this roof.
______ is thankful for a favorite spot in our home.
Let love live in every room we share.
togetherLine: God, thank you for this home you've given us. Amen.

title: Show Me Who to Help
lines: Father, show me who needs help today.
Give me eyes to see the tired and the lonely.
Let my hands be quick to serve, not to complain.
Help me share what I have without keeping count.
Teach me that serving others is serving you.
______ wants to help someone feel less alone this week.
Use our whole family to bless the people around us.
togetherLine: Lord, make us servants with joyful hearts. Amen.

title: A Cupful to Spare
lines: Lord, you filled our jar before we even asked,
teach our fingers to unclench and share.
When I have two cookies, help me offer one,
when my friend forgot their coat, let me lend mine.
Today I want to give away my ______,
because you gave us everything first.
Make our house a place where nobody leaves empty.
togetherLine: Lord, make our hands open wide. Amen.

title: Little Lion, Big Courage
lines: God of mighty roars and quiet whispers,
you put courage in creatures small and short.
When the diving board looks too high, stand with me.
When I must speak up for a friend, give me words.
Today help me be brave about my ______,
even when my hands feel shaky.
You are stronger than every scary thing I face.
togetherLine: God, be our courage when we feel small. Amen.

title: Friends Along the Path
lines: Jesus, you called ordinary people your friends,
thank you for the ones who walk beside me.
For the friend who shares their swing and their snack,
for the one who laughs at all my silly jokes,
today I'm especially thankful for ______,
help me be a good friend back to them.
Keep our friendships kind, and full of grace.
togetherLine: Thank you, Jesus, for friends who walk with us. Amen.

title: Giggles With the Sunrise
lines: God of golden mornings, you wake the world with light,
thank you for eyes that open to another day.
I stretch my arms and feel your joy already here,
pancakes, puddles, or plain old cereal—thank you.
Today I giggle because you gave me ______,
fill this morning with silly, happy noise.
Let joy bounce through our house before we even leave it.
togetherLine: God, thank you for this bright new day. Amen.

title: Rough Patches, Real Peace
lines: Father, some days scrape our knees and our hearts too,
when nothing fits and everything feels crooked.
You don't ask us to smile through the sting,
you sit close and let us lean on you.
Today my hard thing is ______,
carry it with me so it's not so heavy.
Tomorrow is coming, softer than today.
togetherLine: Father, hold us close on hard days. Amen.

title: Popcorn Thanks and Warm Toes
lines: Thank you, God, for popcorn nights and silly knock-knock jokes,
We clap for warm soup and blankets pulled up tight,
Bless the dog who wags when we walk through the door,
Today I'm especially thankful for ______,
Thanks for crayons, puddles, and the smell of fresh bread,
We notice the little gifts you tuck into ordinary hours,
Keep our eyes open for more surprises tomorrow.
togetherLine: Thank you, God, for this whole beautiful day. Amen.

title: Backpack Buddies and Bright Ideas
lines: Lord Jesus, sharpen our minds like pencils ready to write,
Help numbers make sense and letters line up neat,
When a problem feels tangled, untie it in our thoughts,
Give us patience for the kid who sits beside us,
Today I want to get better at ______,
Turn mistakes into stepping stones instead of stumbling blocks,
Thank you for teachers who cheer us toward tomorrow.
togetherLine: Fill our heads and hearts with good things to learn. Amen.

title: Nightlight Whispers of Peace
lines: Father, the house is quiet and the stars are punching through,
Fold up our worries and tuck them under your wing,
You never nod off, even when our eyelids do,
Chase the shadows out from every corner of this room,
Tonight I hand you my thought about ______,
Let dreams be soft and morning come up gentle,
We rest because you're awake and watching close.
togetherLine: We trust you with tonight, Lord. Amen.

title: Letters to Far Off Friends
lines: God of every language, we think of friends we've never met,
Some are teaching, some are healing, some just holding hands,
Bless the ones far from home who carry your good news,
Protect them on dusty roads and over rolling seas,
Today we pray by name for ______,
Give them courage on the hard, lonely days,
Use our little family to send love that far.
togetherLine: Go with your workers, Lord, wherever they walk today. Amen.

title: Owl Wisdom for Little Steps
lines: Wise God, we ask for more than just the right answer,
Help us choose kind over quick and true over easy,
When two paths open up, point us toward the good one,
Solomon asked you for wisdom—we're asking too,
Give me wisdom for ______,
Let us listen twice as much as we talk,
Grow our understanding deep like roots underground.
togetherLine: Lord, make us wise in small things and big. Amen.

title: Waiting Turns Us Gentle
lines: Lord, my feet want to run before you say go.
Teach me to breathe slow when the line is long.
Help me smile while my brother takes his turn.
Show me how a seed waits quiet under the ground.
When my plans get stuck, keep my heart soft and kind.
I bring you my hurry, ______, and ask for your peace.
Grow patience in me like a flower that takes its time.
togetherLine: Lord, teach our hearts to wait with love. Amen.

title: The Sky Keeps Changing Coats
lines: God of orange leaves and silver frost,
You paint pumpkins orange and summer skies blue.
Thank you for snowflakes that never look the same.
Thank you for buds that wake up in spring rain.
You know when the geese should fly and when they should stay.
I love the season of ______ most of all.
Every leaf that falls says you are still making things new.
togetherLine: Maker of seasons, we praise you today. Amen.

title: Safe Beneath Your Feathers
lines: Father, wrap your wings around our roof tonight,
Keep the shadows outside from ever knocking here.
Watch over the roads our family drives on.
Hold your hand above our beds while we dream.
When thunder cracks loud, remind us you are near.
Please keep ______ safe wherever they are tonight.
You never blink, you never sleep, you never leave.
togetherLine: We rest safe in your care tonight. Amen.

title: Palms Open Like Petals
lines: Jesus, you multiplied five loaves for a hungry crowd,
Show us pockets we can empty for someone else.
Let our toys find new hands to play with them.
Teach us to share our snack before we're asked.
Make room in our hearts for one more guest at the table.
Today I want to give ______ to someone who needs it.
Fill us up so we can pour ourselves out for others.
togetherLine: Make our hands open and our hearts wide. Amen.

title: Courage Rides in My Chest
lines: Lord, my knees shake but you steady my stand,
Give me courage to try the thing that scares me most.
Help me speak up when something isn't fair.
Remind me that David was small but you made him brave.
When the dark feels big, make your light feel bigger.
Help me be brave about ______ even when I'm nervous.
Put your strength inside my chest like a drum that beats bold.
togetherLine: With you beside us, we can be brave. Amen.

title: Gathered Under One Roof
lines: We open the big doors and step inside together.
Voices blend into one song lifted high.
Bright windows spill color across the floor.
Bless the hands that teach us and the hearts that welcome us.
We share bread and peace with people we love.
______, thank you for the friend who sits beside me at church.
Keep our church strong, kind, and full of your light.
togetherLine: We are your church, now and always, Amen.

title: Love That Fills Our House
lines: Our home is small but our love is big.
Hugs at breakfast, hugs before bed.
We laugh loud and forgive quick.
Thank you for the ones who hold my hand.
______, I love you because you make me smile.
Even when we squabble, love finds its way back.
Bind our hearts together, today and always.
togetherLine: We are family, and we love each other well, Amen.

title: Still and Satisfied
lines: We have a warm bed and a full plate tonight.
We don't need more toys to feel glad.
Simple things make our hearts light.
Thank you for teaching us to want what we have.
______, I am happy with the little things I already own.
Quiet hearts don't chase what they don't need.
Help us rest easy in what you've given.
togetherLine: We are content, right here, right now, Amen.

title: Thankful Voices Rise
lines: We count our blessings on our fingers tonight.
Thank you for breakfast, for laughter, for light.
Every gift, big or small, comes from your hand.
We say thanks before we even ask for more.
______, I am thankful for something that happened today.
Gratitude turns our grumbles into songs.
Fill our hearts with thanks that never runs dry.
togetherLine: Thank you, God, for all you give, Amen.

title: Lessons Wrapped in Wonder
lines: New words wait for us on every page.
Numbers line up like little puzzles to solve.
Thank you for teachers who help us grow smart.
We ask questions and you help us find answers.
______, help me learn something new and exciting today.
Mistakes are just steps on the way to understanding.
Fill our minds with wisdom and our hearts with wonder.
togetherLine: We are ready to learn all you have for us, Amen.

title: Words We Can Trust
lines: Lord Jesus, help my mouth match my heart today,
Teach me to tell the truth even when it's hard,
Keep my whispers clean and my promises real,
Help ______ speak kindly and speak what's true,
When I want to hide something, help me tell you first,
Make our family a safe place for honest words,
Thank you for loving me even when I mess up.
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, make our words honest and our hearts light. Amen.

title: Doors to Tomorrow
lines: God of new mornings, we stand at the edge of something new,
Thank you for chances to try again and grow,
Help us leave yesterday's mistakes where they belong,
Give ______ courage to start this new thing bravely,
Turn our nervous flutters into hopeful steps,
Walk beside us as we open this next door,
We trust you with everything we don't know yet.
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, lead us into what's next. Amen.

title: Journeys You Watch Over
lines: Father, we buckle up and look down the long road ahead,
Thank you for maps, for signs, and for safe wheels,
Watch over every turn and every tired mile,
Keep ______ safe whether we fly, drive, or float,
Help us be patient when the trip feels long,
Bring us safely to where we're going,
And bring us safely home again too.
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, hold our whole journey in your hands. Amen.

title: Growing in the Waiting
lines: God of slow things, teach us to wait without grumbling,
Help me breathe slow when I want things fast,
Some things grow best when we don't rush them,
Give ______ patience when waiting feels impossible,
Help us be kind while we wait our turn,
Remind us good things take their own good time,
Thank you for being patient with us too.
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, grow patience in our hearts. Amen.

title: Petals, Frost, and Sun
lines: Maker of mornings, we see your hand in every season,
Thank you for spring buds and summer's warm light,
Thank you for crunchy leaves and winter's hush,
Show ______ something beautiful outside today,
Every color and cloud was your idea first,
We watch the seasons turn and think of you,
Thank you for making our world so wonderfully alive.
togetherLine: Together we say: Lord, we praise you for the changing seasons. Amen.

title: Trumpets and Twirling Feet
lines: Clap your hands, the day has come!
God of joy, you love a party,
You turn plain days into dancing,
Thank you for cake and confetti and songs,
Today I am thankful for ______,
Let our laughter rise up like balloons,
Fill this room with joy that spills over.
togetherLine: We celebrate you, Lord, together, hooray! Amen.

title: Sharing Sugar and Smiles
lines: Lord, thank you for the people who live near us,
The ones who wave and say good morning,
Help us bring soup when someone is sick,
And knock on doors just to say hello,
Bless ______ who lives close to our home,
Teach us to be a good neighbor too,
Make our street a place full of kindness.
togetherLine: God, help us love our neighbors well. Amen.

title: Quiet in the Storm
lines: Jesus, you calmed the wind and waves,
Speak peace over our noisy hearts,
When voices shout, let your calm be louder,
Slow our breathing, slow our worry,
Help ______ feel safe and still,
Let peace sit with us at the table,
Carry us gently through today's storms.
togetherLine: Prince of Peace, still our hearts now. Amen.

title: Stained Glass and Sunday Smiles
lines: Father, thank you for our church family,
For the friends who pray beside us,
For songs that lift us up together,
For teachers who share your word with love,
Bless ______ who leads us in worship,
Help us welcome new faces with open arms,
Grow our church like a strong little garden.
togetherLine: Lord, we're glad to belong here. Amen.

title: Hugs That Never Run Out
lines: God, thank you for this messy, happy family,
For hugs before breakfast and after bedtime,
For laughter that bounces off our walls,
For love that stays even on hard days,
I'm grateful for ______ in our family,
Help us forgive quick and hug quicker,
Keep our love growing bigger every year.
togetherLine: We love each other because you loved us first. Amen.

title: Knit Back Together
lines: Lord Jesus, you touched the sick and they stood up strong,
Come near to the parts of us that hurt today.
Mend the ache in ______'s body, gentle and true.
Hold the doctors' hands as they help us get well.
Turn our worried nights into peaceful, healing sleep.
Thank you for medicine, rest, and soup that warms.
Grow us stronger, inside and out, day by day.
togetherLine: We trust you to heal us, Lord, Amen.

title: The Weight We Set Down
lines: Father, we carry things we wish we hadn't done,
You forgive us fully, every single time.
Help ______ say sorry and truly mean it.
Teach us to forgive each other, even when it's hard.
Wash away the grudges hiding in our hearts.
Let peace replace the prickly feeling inside.
Thank you for wiping our slate completely clean.
togetherLine: We let go and forgive, just as you forgive us, Amen.

title: When Tears Fall Near Us
lines: God of comfort, someone close to us is sad tonight,
Wrap your arms around the ones who are crying.
Show us how to sit beside a hurting friend.
Help ______ know just what kind words to say.
Send helpers to families who feel alone right now.
Turn our hands into hands that comfort others.
Remind us that you are near the broken-hearted.
togetherLine: We ask you to comfort every hurting heart, Amen.

title: Straight From the Heart
lines: Quiet confession: sometimes little fibs feel easier than truth,
But you love honesty even when it's hard to say.
Give ______ the courage to tell things exactly as they are.
Help our words and our hearts always match up.
Keep us from hiding behind half-true stories.
Make our family a safe place for real answers.
Thank you for loving us when we tell the truth.
togetherLine: We choose honesty, plain and simple, Amen.

title: Beginning Where We Stand
lines: God of open roads, today feels like a brand new page,
You make old things new and give us fresh starts.
Help ______ step bravely into what's coming next.
Turn our mistakes into lessons that help us grow.
Thank you for second chances and new beginnings.
Walk with us into whatever this new season brings.
We trust you with everything still unwritten ahead.
togetherLine: We begin again today, with you leading the way, Amen.
